items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉美元走強、美債殖利率飆高 黃金周線連6週5跌
items.title_en: <Precious Metals After Hours> Dollar Strengthens, U.S. Treasury Yields Surge, Gold Weekly Chart Shows 5 Down Weeks in 6
paras: 黃金價格周五(2日)走弱,儘管美國9月就業數據遠低於市場預期,一度推動金價大幅反彈,但美元仍維持本周升勢,加上美國長天期公債殖利率持續處於高檔,令不孳息黃金承受壓力,金價本周料將連續第2週下跌,並創下近6週來第5週收黑。
現貨黃金周五盤中一度上漲逾1%,隨後轉跌,截至美東時間上午11時38分下跌0.8%,報每盎司4,145.68美元,本周累計跌幅約3.3%。美國黃金期貨則一度上漲,截至盤中下跌約0.7%,報每盎司4,173.50美元。以收盤數據計,黃金期貨本周下跌約3.4%,現貨金則下跌約3.3%。
金價盤初受到美國就業市場急劇降溫帶動,投資人重新降低對聯準會(Fed)近期升息的押注。美國勞工部公布,9月非農就業人口僅增加2.9萬人,遠低於市場預期的約8.9萬人,也是今年以來最慢的月度增幅。
同時,8月非農就業增幅遭下修至13.3萬人,較原先公布的16.2萬人減少2.9萬人。7月及8月非農就業人口合計下修6萬人,顯示近期美國勞動市場降溫程度可能較先前數據所呈現的更加明顯。
失業率也由8月的4.1%升至9月的4.2%。疲弱的就業數據提高市場對Fed降息或至少暫緩升息的預期,理論上有利於金價,因為黃金不支付利息,當債券殖利率下降時,持有黃金的機會成本也會降低。
然而,美債市場並未延續就業數據公布後的最初反應。美國10年期及30年期公債殖利率周四(1日)已升至2002年以來最高水準,周五盤中雖曾因就業數據疲弱而下降,之後再度反彈,使黃金缺乏持續上攻的利多條件。
截至周五,美國10年期公債殖利率約為5.26%,30年期殖利率約5.62%。本周10年期殖利率累計上升約10個基點,30年期則上升約13個基點。2年期殖利率則受到Fed升息預期下降影響,本周約下滑3個基點。
美債殖利率大幅走高也帶動美元本周升值,美元指數周五雖從高點回落,但仍朝連續第3週上漲邁進。美元走強會提高以美元計價黃金對其他貨幣持有人的購買成本,進一步壓抑國際金價。
市場對Fed政策的預期則在一周內出現劇烈變化。根據CME Group(CME-US)的FedWatch工具,投資人對10月升息的預期已從本周稍早約70%大幅降至約26%,顯示弱於預期的就業市場已明顯降低市場對Fed本月升息的押注。
不過,市場對12月升息的預期仍然存在,顯示投資人並未完全排除Fed在今年稍晚重新收緊政策的可能性。近期能源價格上升、通膨壓力及美國財政赤字擴大,均使長天期美債殖利率維持高檔,這也成為黃金價格的重要壓力來源。
黃金在9月已經歷明顯修正,當月跌幅超過6%。此前金價曾在8月創下高點,但之後自高點回落逾12%,進入10月後仍受到美元及債券市場波動牽動。從周線來看,金價已在過去6週中的5週下跌。
市場分析人士指出,疲弱就業數據本身對黃金屬於利多,但若美債殖利率因通膨、財政赤字或長期供給壓力持續走高,黃金仍可能受到壓抑。換言之,目前金市關注焦點已不只是Fed是否升息,也包括長天期美債殖利率能否從逾20年高位回落。
另一方面,中東地緣政治風險仍為黃金提供一定支撐。美國與伊朗之間的衝突及後續外交進展仍受到市場密切關注,投資人也持續評估能源供應、通膨及全球經濟成長可能受到的影響。地緣政治不確定性通常會增加黃金的避險需求,但目前其支撐力仍不足以完全抵銷美元及美債殖利率上升帶來的壓力。
其他貴金屬同樣受到美元及利率環境影響。白銀周五盤中下跌,本周跌幅進一步擴大;鉑金及鈀金則同樣面臨周線下跌壓力,顯示近期貴金屬市場整體仍處於高波動環境。
市場接下來將持續關注Fed官員對就業數據及通膨的最新看法,以及美元與美債殖利率是否進一步攀升。若長天期殖利率維持高檔,黃金可能持續面臨壓力;反之,若就業降溫促使市場重新加大降息押注,並帶動美元及債券殖利率同步走低,則可能重新為黃金提供上行動能。
paras_en: Gold prices weakened on Friday (the 2nd), even though U.S. September employment data came in far below expectations and briefly sparked a sharp rebound, the dollar kept its weekly advance and long‑term U.S. Treasury yields stayed elevated, pressuring non‑yield‑bearing gold. The metal is expected to post a second consecutive weekly decline and record its fifth losing week in roughly six weeks.

Spot gold rose more than 1% intraday on Friday before turning lower, ending down 0.8% at $4,145.68 per ounce as of 11:38 a.m. Eastern Time, a cumulative weekly drop of about 3.3%. U.S. gold futures also rose briefly, later slipping about 0.7% to $4,173.50 per ounce. Based on closing prices, gold futures fell roughly 3.4% for the week, while spot gold fell about 3.3%.

The price action at the start of the session was driven by a sharp cooling in the U.S. labor market, prompting investors to scale back bets on near‑term Fed rate hikes. The Labor Department reported that September non‑farm payrolls increased by only 29,000 jobs, far below the roughly 89,000 jobs analysts had forecast and the slowest monthly gain this year.

At the same time, August’s non‑farm payroll figure was revised down to 133,000 from the originally reported 162,000, a reduction of 29,000. The combined July‑August payroll total was cut by 60,000, suggesting that the recent slowdown in the U.S. labor market may be more pronounced than earlier data indicated.

The unemployment rate also rose from 4.1% in August to 4.2% in September. Weak jobs data lifted market expectations for a Fed rate cut or at least a pause, which in theory should support gold because the metal pays no interest; when bond yields fall, the opportunity cost of holding gold declines.

However, the Treasury market did not sustain the initial reaction to the jobs report. U.S. 10‑year and 30‑year yields had already climbed to their highest levels since 2002 on Thursday (the 1st), and although they fell briefly on Friday after the weak jobs data, they quickly rebounded, depriving gold of a lasting bullish catalyst.

As of Friday, the U.S. 10‑year yield was about 5.26% and the 30‑year yield about 5.62%. The 10‑year yield rose roughly 10 basis points this week, while the 30‑year rose about 13 basis points. The 2‑year yield, meanwhile, slipped about 3 basis points as expectations for Fed hikes eased.

The sharp rise in Treasury yields also lifted the dollar this week; the dollar index fell back from its peak on Friday but still moved toward a third consecutive week of gains. A stronger dollar raises the cost of dollar‑denominated gold for holders of other currencies, further suppressing international gold prices.

Market expectations for Fed policy shifted dramatically over the week. According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, investors’ probability of an October rate hike fell from roughly 70% earlier in the week to about 26%, reflecting how the softer‑than‑expected jobs market has cut bets on a September Fed hike.

Nevertheless, expectations for a December hike remain, indicating that investors have not ruled out the possibility of the Fed tightening again later this year. Recent energy price spikes, inflation pressures and a widening U.S. fiscal deficit keep long‑term Treasury yields high, which continues to weigh on gold.

Gold has already undergone a noticeable correction in September, falling more than 6% for the month. After hitting a peak in August, the metal retreated over 12% from that high and remains influenced by dollar and bond market swings into October. On a weekly basis, gold has fallen in five of the past six weeks.

Analysts note that weak jobs data is fundamentally bullish for gold, but if Treasury yields stay elevated due to inflation, fiscal deficits or long‑term supply pressures, gold could remain under pressure. In other words, the market’s focus now extends beyond whether the Fed raises rates to whether long‑term U.S. yields can retreat from a more than 20‑year high.

On the other hand, Middle‑East geopolitical risk still provides some support for gold. Ongoing tensions between the United States and Iran and related diplomatic developments are closely watched, as investors assess potential impacts on energy supplies, inflation and global growth. Geopolitical uncertainty usually boosts gold’s safe‑haven appeal, but currently it is insufficient to fully offset the headwinds from a stronger dollar and higher yields.

Other precious metals are similarly affected by the dollar and rate environment. Silver fell intraday on Friday, extending its weekly decline; platinum and palladium also faced weekly downside pressure, indicating that the broader precious‑metal market remains in a highly volatile setting.

Going forward, markets will keep an eye on Fed officials’ latest views on jobs and inflation, as well as whether the dollar and Treasury yields continue to climb. If long‑term yields stay high, gold may remain under pressure; conversely, if a cooling labor market spurs renewed bets on rate cuts and pulls the dollar and bond yields lower, gold could regain upward momentum.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉非農爆冷！降息預期激勵美股收紅 那指周線喜提連三紅
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: Cold Nonfarm Payrolls Boosted Markets, Nasdaq Posts Third Consecutive Weekly Gain
paras: 美國 9 月非農就業報告顯著降溫，市場對聯準會可能升息的預期降溫，激勵美股三大指數週五 (2 日) 全面收紅。科技股為衝鋒主力，那指盤中一度飆上新高，終場收漲 1.19% 至 27,190.86 點，距離 9 月 22 日創下的歷史高點 (27,244.28 點) 僅差不到 0.2%。
總經數據方面，美國勞工部公布 9 月非農就業僅新增 2.9 萬人，遠低於市場預期的 8.4 萬人，前兩個月的就業數據亦遭到下修；失業率則受勞動參與率提升影響，由 4.1% 略升至 4.2%，平均時薪增幅則同步放緩。
這份弱於預期的就業數據，促使投資人重新評估 Fed 的貨幣政策走向。芝商所 (CME) FedWatch 工具顯示，市場預期 Fed 在 10 月會議降息或維持利率不變的押注顯著升溫，政策緊縮壓力大為減輕。
股市表現方面，AI 巨頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 盤中再創歷史新高，超微 (AMD-US) 與資安族群同步強勢走揚，推升那斯達克 100 指數刷新紀錄。加密貨幣概念股早盤受比特幣重返 86,000 美元關卡激勵躍升，唯隨後走勢分化。
此外，七大工業國集團 (G7) 釋出可能動用緊急戰略準備的訊號後，西德州原油 (WTI) 期貨重挫 1.5% 至每桶 91.48 美元，油價顯著回落進一步撫平市場恐慌情緒。
不過，美債市場走勢出現波動。指標性的美國 10 年期公債殖利率在報告公布初時一度急挫，但隨後逆勢轉升約 4 個基點至 5.28%，壓抑了美股尾盤的漲幅。
分析指出，債市除了反映物價黏性與政府擴大財政支出外，科技巨頭為擴建 AI 基礎設施而大量發債，亦對市場流動性帶來壓力。
美股週五 (2 日) 主要指數表現：

道瓊工業指數上漲 250.40 點，或 0.49%，報 51,176.96 點。
那斯達克指數上漲 319.27 點，或 1.19%，報 27,190.86 點。
S&P 500 指數上漲 56.27 點，或 0.73%，報 7,722.72 點。
費城半導體指數上漲 307.68 點，或 2.40%，報 13,136.68 點。
NYSE FANG+ 指數上漲 106.87 點，或 0.56%，報 19,211.64 點。


週線表現部分，儘管道瓊與標普本週分別累跌 1.26% 與 0.27%，但那斯達克指數展現韌性，本週逆勢上揚 0.45%，締造連續第 3 週收升紀錄。
焦點個股
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭集體攀揚。Meta (META-US) 上漲 0.30%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.02%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 1.56%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.92%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 1.33%。
半導體主要個股普遍走高。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 2.95%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 3.35%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 1.34%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 2.03%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.53%。
記憶體與儲存族群多數下挫。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 2.05%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 重挫 10.22%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 3.79%；希捷 (STX-US) 重挫 10.21%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 0.84%。
台股 ADR 全紅。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 2.96%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 大漲 6.08%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 4.20%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 1.34%。
企業新聞
輝達 (NVDA-US) 收高 1.34%，收在 233.95 美元，逼近歷史收盤高點。輝達先前於 5 月 14 日創下 235.74 美元的收盤紀錄。公司近日將股票回購計畫額度增加 1,500 億美元，創史上最大規模。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 勁揚 4.65% 至每股 370.59 美元。這家電動車大廠第三季交車 486,532 輛，較第二季增加 1%，較去年同期減少 2%，但仍大幅優於華爾街預期。
Rivian (RIVN-US) 第三季交車 19,248 輛，高於市場預估的 18,001 輛，股價仍收黑 3.1% 至每股 14.30 美元。
安森美半導體 (ON-US) 飛升 6.01%。Synaptics (SYNA-US) 狂飆超 14%。安森美半導體同意以 57 億美元現金收購 Synaptics ，取代先前價值 70 億美元的股票交易方案。
Nike (NKE-US) 週五跌幅超 3.5%。公司第一季營收未達華爾街預期，並提出疲弱的全年財測，顯示營運轉型仍面臨挑戰。
慧與科技 (HPE-US) 噴高 7.36%，名列標普指數漲幅最大的成分股之一。慧與表示，AI 需求可望帶動網路業務營收穩健成長。
《日經》報導，東芝計劃投資 3.8 億美元擴建菲律賓廠區，將資料中心用硬碟 (HDD) 產能提高至目前的 2 倍。消息衝擊同業股價，希捷科技 (STX-US) 下殺 10.21%，威騰電子 (WDC-US) 也狂瀉 10%。
莫德納 (MRNA-US) 上漲約 0.6%。那斯達克交易所宣布，公司將於 10 月 9 日開盤前取代華納兄弟探索 (WBD-US)，納入那斯達克 100 指數。華納兄弟探索預計下週完成與 Paramount Skydance 的合併。
華爾街分析
Nuveen 投資長 Saira Malik 認為，非農就業報告可望在財報季啟動前支撐市場，並預期接下來的企業獲利表現將相當強勁。
不過，eToro 分析師 Bret Kenwell 提醒，疲弱就業數據可能再次帶動「壞消息就是好消息」的交易邏輯，但若勞動市場明顯惡化，將為經濟帶來另一項挑戰。他指出，10 年期美債殖利率的 5% 關卡值得關注，若成為新的低檔支撐，股市能否持續承受高利率將受到考驗。
Edward Jones 策略師 Angelo Kourkafas 則表示，最新數據顯示勞動市場正在降溫，但基本面仍健康。儘管高利率與地緣政治不確定性可能壓抑估值、加劇波動，持續擴張的經濟與穩健的企業獲利成長，仍可望支撐美股今年剩餘時間的表現。
