paras_en: U.S. September nonfarm payrolls cooled sharply, easing market expectations of further Fed rate hikes and prompting all three major U.S. equity indexes to close higher on Friday (the 2nd). Tech stocks led the rally, with the Nasdaq soaring to a new intraday high before finishing up 1.19% at 27,190.86 points, just under 0.2% shy of the September 22 record peak of 27,244.28 points.

On the macro side, the Labor Department reported that September added only 29,000 jobs, far below the 84,000 forecast, and the figures for the prior two months were also revised down. The unemployment rate ticked up slightly from 4.1% to 4.2% as labor‑force participation rose, while average hourly earnings growth slowed.

The weaker‑than‑expected payrolls led investors to reassess the Fed’s policy path. CME’s FedWatch tool shows a sharp rise in bets that the Fed will either cut rates or hold them steady at the October meeting, easing tightening pressure considerably.

In equities, AI heavyweight Nvidia (NVDA-US) hit another all‑time high during the session, while AMD and cybersecurity stocks surged, pushing the Nasdaq‑100 to a fresh record. Crypto‑related stocks jumped early after Bitcoin reclaimed the $86,000 level, but later showed mixed performance.

In addition, after the G7 signaled it might tap emergency strategic reserves, West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures fell 1.5% to $91.48 a barrel, pulling oil prices down and calming market panic.

U.S. Treasury markets were volatile. The benchmark 10‑year yield plunged sharply right after the report’s release, then rebounded about four basis points to 5.28%, tempering the equity rally in the closing minutes.

Analysts note that the bond market reflects not only sticky inflation and expanded fiscal spending but also heavy issuance by tech giants financing AI infrastructure, which pressures market liquidity.
U.S. equity performance on Friday (the 2nd):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 250.40 points, or 0.49%, to 51,176.96. The Nasdaq Composite gained 319.27 points, or 1.19%, to 27,190.86. The S&P 500 climbed 56.27 points, or 0.73%, to 7,722.72. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 307.68 points, or 2.40%, to 13,136.68. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 106.87 points, or 0.56%, to 19,211.64.  On the weekly chart, although the Dow and S&P fell 1.26% and 0.27% respectively this week, the Nasdaq showed resilience, gaining 0.45% and marking its third straight week of advances.
Focus stocks

The five big tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index all moved higher: Meta (META‑US) up 0.30%, Apple (AAPL‑US) up 1.02%, Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) up 1.56%, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) up 0.92% and Amazon (AMZN‑US) up 1.33%.
Semiconductor leaders also rose: AMD (AMD‑US) up 2.95%, Broadcom (AVGO‑US) up 3.35%, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) up 1.34%, Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) up 2.03% and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) up 1.53%.

Memory and storage stocks mostly fell: Micron (MU‑US) down 2.05%, Western Digital (WDC‑US) plunged 10.22%, SanDisk (SNDK‑US) down 3.79%, Seagate (STX‑US) down 10.21%, while SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) rose 0.84%.
All Taiwan‑related ADRs were up: TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) up 2.96%, ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) surged 6.08%, UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 4.20% and Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) up 1.34%.
Company news
Nvidia (NVDA‑US) closed up 1.34% at $233.95, near its all‑time closing high of $235.74 set on May 14. The company recently expanded its share‑repurchase program by $150 billion, the largest ever.
Tesla (TSLA‑US) jumped 4.65% to $370.59. The automaker delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3, a 1% increase from Q2 but a 2% decline year‑over‑year, still far ahead of Wall Street forecasts.
Rivian (RIVN‑US) delivered 19,248 vehicles in Q3, beating the consensus estimate of 18,001, yet the stock closed down 3.1% at $14.30.

ON Semiconductor (ON‑US) surged 6.01% and Synaptics (SYNA‑US) rocketed more than 14% after ON agreed to acquire Synaptics for $5.7 billion in cash, replacing an earlier $7 billion stock‑swap proposal.

Nike (NKE‑US) fell more than 3.5% on Friday after first‑quarter revenue missed Wall Street expectations and the company issued a weak full‑year outlook, signaling ongoing challenges in its transformation plan.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) jumped 7.36%, making it one of the biggest gainers in the S&P 500. The firm said rising AI demand should drive solid growth in its networking revenue.

According to the Nikkei, Toshiba plans to invest $380 million to expand its Philippine plant, doubling HDD capacity for data‑center use. The news sent peers tumbling, with Seagate (STX‑US) down 10.21% and Western Digital (WDC‑US) plunging 10%.

Moderna (MRNA‑US) rose about 0.6% after Nasdaq announced that the company will replace Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD‑US) in the Nasdaq‑100 effective before the opening on October 9. Warner Bros. Discovery is expected to complete its merger with Paramount Skydance next week.
Wall Street commentary
Nuveen Chief Investment Officer Saira Malik said the payroll report should help support markets ahead of earnings season and expects corporate earnings to remain robust.

However, eToro analyst Bret Kenwell warned that weak jobs data could revive the “bad news is good news” trade, but a clearly deteriorating labor market would pose a new economic challenge. He highlighted the 5% level on the 10‑year Treasury as a key support to watch; if it holds, the equity market’s ability to endure high rates will be tested.

Edward Jones strategist Angelo Kourkafas noted that the latest data show the labor market cooling while fundamentals stay healthy. Although high rates and geopolitical uncertainty may suppress valuations and increase volatility, a still‑expanding economy and solid corporate profit growth should underpin U.S. equities for the rest of the year.
All figures are updated as of the deadline; please refer to actual market quotes for the latest numbers.

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉G7宣布釋放1億桶油品儲備 油價承壓小跌 但市場仍盯中東供應
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: G7 Announces Release of 100 Million Barrels of Oil Reserves, Oil Prices Slip Slightly but Market Still Focuses on Middle East Supply
paras: 國際油價周五(2日)收低，市場消化歐洲同意釋放柴油戰略儲備的消息。G7國家稍後進一步宣布，將透過國際能源總署(IEA)協調，在4個月內釋放合計1億桶原油、柴油及其他石油產品儲備，且前20天將提前釋出大量柴油，以緩解燃料供應緊張及高油價壓力。
布蘭特原油(Brent)12月期貨周五收跌6美分或0.06%，報每桶102.25美元；美國西德州中級原油(WTI)11月期貨下跌1.76美元或1.90%，報每桶91.11美元。全周來看，Brent上漲0.11%，WTI則下跌1.6%。此前油價周四大幅走高，Brent單日上漲逾4美元，WTI也上漲逾2美元，主要受到中國暫停成品油出口及美國可能增派兵力前往中東等消息推動。
歐盟國家周五同意法國提出的柴油儲備釋放方案。根據知情人士說法，法國原先提出歐洲國家釋放約5,000萬桶柴油，並由IEA成員國另外釋放5,000萬桶原油，其中部分柴油庫存將在約20天內釋出。
隨後G7領袖透過聲明確認，將透過IEA協調釋放1億桶緊急儲備，行動立即開始並持續4個月，前20天將由G7成員及合作夥伴大幅提前釋出柴油。各國並承諾避免彼此實施能源及能源產品出口限制，同時呼籲其他能源生產國不要採取可能進一步加劇市場緊張的出口禁令。
美國總統川普此前持續要求歐洲釋放柴油儲備，以降低燃料價格及歐洲對美國柴油進口的依賴。川普周五表示，歐洲已同意釋出「大量」儲存柴油，相關程序將立即開始。此前川普曾表示正在考慮禁止美國柴油出口，以增加美國國內供應並壓低燃料價格，但周五又表示美國不會實施柴油出口禁令。
歐洲之所以成為美國施壓的主要對象，與其柴油供應對外依賴程度提高有關。俄烏戰爭後歐洲大幅降低俄羅斯成品油進口，加上中東能源供應受到干擾，使美國柴油在歐洲市場的重要性明顯上升。美國若限制柴油出口，可能進一步壓縮歐洲燃料供應，因此歐洲釋放戰略儲備成為降低市場壓力的替代方案。
根據歐盟統計資料，若按照法國提出的5,000萬桶柴油釋放規模計算，相當於歐盟柴油及汽油庫存約17%，約占歐盟全年柴油消費量3%。在相關消息傳出後，美國柴油期貨一度下跌約3.25%至每加侖4.49美元，歐洲基準柴油期貨則下跌約83美元或5.75%，反映市場對新增供應的反應。
能源市場目前的主要壓力也正逐漸由原油本身轉向成品油。Saxo Bank認為，隨著中東原油流量有所恢復，市場目前最大的壓力已不再完全是原油供應不足，而是中東及俄羅斯煉油產能與產量受到限制，使柴油等成品油供應更加緊張。
另一方面，中國煉油商近期暫停向香港及澳門以外地區出口成品油，也成為油價的重要支撐因素。中國在今年3月伊朗戰事爆發後限制燃料出口，7月一度放寬，但目前仍採取按月管理柴油、汽油及航空煤油出口的方式。中國主要煉油商10月尚未取得向香港及澳門以外市場出口的許可，市場仍在觀察10月7日長假結束後北京是否恢復相關出口。
美國中東軍事部署同樣增加市場不確定性。華爾街日報此前報導，美國正向中東派遣第3艘航空母艦及最多1萬名額外部隊，川普則考慮在美國期中選舉後是否恢復對伊朗的軍事打擊。市場同時關注美伊關係、荷姆茲海峽航運以及中東原油出口恢復速度。
此外，烏克蘭持續攻擊俄羅斯能源基礎設施。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基表示，烏軍過去24小時內攻擊俄羅斯薩馬拉及伏爾加格勒地區的石油設施。俄羅斯煉油與成品油出口受到干擾，也是全球柴油供應緊張的重要因素之一。
Capital Economics認為，如果中東原油流量持續回升，加上新一輪戰略儲備釋放，全球石油市場可能重新回到小幅供過於求的狀態。不過，市場基本面並未全面轉弱。
Barclays(BCS-US)則指出，儘管中東原油出口有所改善，實體市場基本面依然強勁，庫存仍在下降，近期交割原油相對遠期合約仍呈現明顯溢價。因此，該行將2026年第4季Brent價格預測上調20美元至每桶115美元，全年預測則上調至每桶100美元。
這意味著戰略儲備釋放雖可在短期內增加柴油與原油供應，但市場仍須觀察中東原油流量、煉油產能、俄羅斯能源出口、中國成品油出口政策以及荷姆茲海峽航運是否持續改善。若供應中斷問題未能根本緩解，新增庫存可能主要提供短期緩衝，而未必足以扭轉整體能源市場的緊張格局。
paras_en: International oil prices closed lower on Friday (the 2nd) as the market digested news that Europe agreed to release diesel strategic reserves. The G7 later announced, via coordination through the International Energy Agency (IEA), a plan to release a total of 100 million barrels of crude oil, diesel and other petroleum products over four months, with a large amount of diesel to be released early in the first 20 days to ease fuel‑supply tightness and high‑price pressure.

Brent crude December futures fell 6 cents, or 0.06%, on Friday to $102.25 a barrel. U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) November futures dropped $1.76, or 1.90%, to $91.11 a barrel. Over the week Brent was up 0.11% while WTI fell 1.6%. Prices had surged on Thursday, with Brent gaining more than $4 in a day and WTI up over $2, driven by news of China halting refined‑oil exports and the United States possibly sending more troops to the Middle East.

EU members on Friday approved the diesel‑reserve release plan put forward by France. According to sources, France initially proposed that European countries release about 50 million barrels of diesel, while IEA member states would release another 50 million barrels of crude oil, with part of the diesel stock to be drawn down over roughly 20 days.

Subsequently G7 leaders confirmed in a statement that, through the IEA, they will release 100 million barrels of emergency reserves, with actions starting immediately and lasting four months, and that diesel will be released in large amounts by G7 members and partners during the first 20 days. The countries also pledged not to impose energy or energy‑product export restrictions on each other and called on other energy‑producing nations not to adopt export bans that could further tighten the market.

U.S. President Trump had repeatedly urged Europe to release diesel reserves to lower fuel prices and reduce Europe’s reliance on U.S. diesel imports. Trump said on Friday that Europe had agreed to release a “large” amount of stored diesel and that the process would begin immediately. He had previously floated the idea of banning U.S. diesel exports to boost domestic supply and push down fuel prices, but on Friday said the United States would not impose a diesel export ban.

Europe has become a primary target of U.S. pressure because its reliance on imported diesel has risen. After the Russia‑Ukraine war, Europe sharply cut imports of Russian refined products, and disruptions to Middle‑East supplies have further increased the importance of U.S. diesel in the European market. A U.S. restriction on diesel exports could further squeeze European fuel supplies, making the release of strategic reserves a preferred way to ease market pressure.

EU statistics show that the 50 million‑barrel diesel release proposed by France would represent roughly 17% of the EU’s diesel and gasoline inventories, about 3% of the bloc’s annual diesel consumption. After the news broke, U.S. diesel futures fell about 3.25% to $4.49 per gallon, while European benchmark diesel futures dropped roughly €83, or 5.75%, reflecting market reaction to the added supply.

The main pressure in the energy market is now shifting from crude oil itself to refined products. Saxo Bank says that with Middle‑East crude flows recovering, the biggest market stress is no longer solely a shortage of crude supply but constraints on refining capacity and output in the Middle East and Russia, which tighten supplies of diesel and other products.

On the other hand, Chinese refiners have recently halted exports of refined products outside Hong Kong and Macau, providing another support to oil prices. China limited fuel exports after the March 2024 outbreak of fighting in Iran, eased the ban briefly in July, but now manages diesel, gasoline and jet‑fuel exports on a monthly basis. Major Chinese refiners have not yet obtained permission to ship to markets beyond Hong Kong and Macau for October, and the market is watching whether Beijing will resume those exports after the October 7 holiday.

U.S. military deployments in the Middle East also add uncertainty. The Wall Street Journal previously reported that the United States is sending a third aircraft carrier and up to 10,000 additional troops to the region, and Trump is weighing whether to resume strikes against Iran after the U.S. mid‑term elections. Markets are also watching U.S.–Iran relations, traffic through the Hormuz Strait and the pace of Middle‑East crude‑oil export recovery.

In addition, Ukraine continues to strike Russian energy infrastructure. President Zelensky said Ukrainian forces attacked oil facilities in Russia’s Samara and Volgograd regions in the past 24 hours. Disruptions to Russian refining and product exports are another key factor tightening global diesel supplies.

Capital Economics believes that if Middle‑East crude flows keep rising and a new round of strategic‑reserve releases occurs, the global oil market could return to a modest surplus. However, the fundamentals have not turned uniformly weak.

Barclays (BCS‑US) notes that despite improved Middle‑East crude exports, the physical market remains strong, inventories are still falling and near‑term spot crude trades at a clear premium to forward contracts. Accordingly, the bank has raised its Q4 2026 Brent price forecast by $20 to $115 a barrel and its full‑year forecast to $100 a barrel.

This means that while the strategic‑reserve release can boost diesel and crude supplies in the short term, the market must still monitor Middle‑East crude flows, refining capacity, Russian energy exports, Chinese refined‑product export policy and Hormuz‑strait shipping for continued improvement. If supply‑disruption issues are not fundamentally resolved, the added inventories may only provide a temporary buffer and may not be enough to reverse the overall tightness in the energy market.

items.title: 杜拜航空爆重大安檢漏洞！副機師遭阿曼禁飛仍獲聘
items.title_en: Dubai Airlines Exposes Major Security Breach! Omani Co‑pilot Banned from Flying Still Hired
paras: 《華爾街日報》報導，該名阿曼籍副機長曾因涉嫌極端化，遭阿曼政府禁止飛行，隨後卻仍獲杜拜航空聘用，並在空中刺傷機長企圖墜機。
杜拜航空 (FlyDubai) 1073 號班機機艙驚魂案有重大進展。據消息人士透露，涉嫌在空中刺傷機長並企圖蓄意墜機的阿曼籍副機長，先前就因涉嫌受到極端思想影響，遭阿曼政府禁止執飛。
然而，杜拜航空之後仍聘用該名機師，甚至安排他執飛阿拉伯聯合大公國與以色列之間的敏感航線，引發外界對跨國航空安全審查機制的質疑。
3 萬呎高空驚魂：乘客與備勤機師聯手化解危機
這起空中攻擊事件發生於本週三上午，班機原定從杜拜飛往特拉維夫。涉案副機長在飛行途中突然持刀刺傷機長，並操控飛機急速俯衝，客機一度因承受過大負荷，接近解體邊緣。
身受重傷的機長在危急之際奮力打開駕駛艙門，乘客與空服員隨即上前，合力制伏攻擊者。同機搭乘的 2 名備勤機師則接手駕駛，成功穩住飛機，並緊急降落沙烏地阿拉伯，化解可能造成重大傷亡的危機。
目前，受傷機長與涉案副機長均已轉送阿聯，相關調查持續進行。杜拜航空也已全面暫停往返杜拜與特拉維夫的航班。
尼坦雅胡定調為「恐怖攻擊」
以色列總理尼坦雅胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 週五明確將事件定調為恐怖攻擊，指稱涉案副機師受到伊斯蘭極端思想影響，企圖讓飛機墜毀，與全機人員同歸於盡。以色列安全單位正調查他是否與特定組織有關，以及是否有共犯，並爭取對其進行訊問。
阿聯當局目前主導調查，但對於涉案副機長在阿曼的過往紀錄，阿聯官方發言人以「避免干預調查或預判結果」為由拒絕評論。阿曼政府與杜拜航空也未回應媒體詢問。
目前尚無法確認，阿曼先前是否曾向其他國家或航空公司通報該名機師涉及的安全疑慮。
安檢與機師審查遭質疑 跨國協調成焦點
航空安全分析師指出，這起事件反映航空安全防線出現嚴重漏洞。雖然涉案刀械如何通過機場安檢仍待釐清，但具有極端思想及潛在攻擊風險的人員，理應在進入機場前，就透過安全審查加以辨識與攔阻。
事件也引發外界檢視杜拜飛往以色列航班的安檢標準。以色列官員透露，以方長期要求杜拜機場強化飛往特拉維夫航班的安全措施。
以色列國家審計長辦公室早在 2024 年 5 月的機密報告中就指出，交通部過度將資源集中於本國航空公司，對外籍航空公司飛往以色列航班的安檢投入明顯不足。此次事件也讓跨國航空安全資訊共享與機師背景審查機制，再度受到關注。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that the Omani co‑pilot, who had been barred from flying by the Omani government over alleged extremist ties, was later hired by Dubai Airlines and stabbed the captain in flight in an attempt to crash the plane.

FlyDubai flight 1073’s cabin incident has seen major developments. Sources say the Omani co‑pilot accused of stabbing the captain and attempting a deliberate crash had previously been prohibited from flying by the Omani authorities for suspected extremist influence.

Nevertheless, Dubai Airlines later employed the pilot and even assigned him to a sensitive route between the United Arab Emirates and Israel, prompting questions about cross‑border airline safety vetting mechanisms.
30,000‑foot terror in the sky: passengers and standby pilots work together to defuse the crisis

The airborne attack occurred on Wednesday morning; the flight was scheduled to depart Dubai for Tel Aviv. The co‑pilot suddenly drew a knife, wounded the captain, and forced the aircraft into a steep dive, subjecting the plane to extreme loads that brought it close to structural failure.

The severely injured captain managed to open the cockpit door in the emergency, and passengers and cabin crew rushed in to subdue the attacker. Two standby pilots on board took over the controls, steadied the aircraft and made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, averting a potentially catastrophic loss of life.
Both the injured captain and the co‑pilot have been transferred to the UAE for further investigation, and Dubai Airlines has suspended all flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv.
Netanyahu labels the incident a "terrorist attack"

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Friday unequivocally described the event as a terrorist attack, saying the co‑pilot was influenced by Islamic extremism and intended to bring down the plane with everyone on board. Israeli security agencies are probing possible links to extremist groups and any accomplices, and are seeking to interrogate the suspect.

The UAE authorities are leading the investigation, but an Emirati spokesperson declined to comment on the co‑pilot’s prior record in Oman, citing a need to avoid interfering with the probe or pre‑judging its outcome. Neither the Omani government nor Dubai Airlines responded to media inquiries.
It remains unclear whether Oman ever notified other countries or airlines about the pilot’s security concerns.
Security screening and pilot vetting come under fire; cross‑border coordination becomes the focus

Aviation safety analysts say the case highlights a serious breach in the aviation security chain. While it is still unknown how the knife passed through airport screening, individuals with extremist views and potential for attack should be identified and stopped during pre‑flight security checks.

The incident has also prompted scrutiny of security standards for Dubai‑to‑Israel flights. Israeli officials say Israel has long urged Dubai Airport to tighten security measures on flights bound for Tel Aviv.

A confidential report from Israel’s State Comptroller’s Office in May 2024 warned that the Ministry of Transport had overly concentrated resources on domestic carriers, leaving security checks for foreign airlines operating flights to Israel markedly under‑funded. This episode has revived attention on international information sharing and pilot background‑check mechanisms.

items.title: AI獨撐美股大盤！美債殖利率飆高股市表面淡定 5大面向暴露內部壓力
items.title_en: AI Propels US Stock Market While Treasury Yields Surge; Stock Market Appears Calm but Five Areas Reveal Internal Pressure
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率周四(1日)一度升至5.34%，創2002年以來新高後，股票交易員正熱烈討論，債市拋售何時會開始對韌性十足的美股造成更大壓力。但從市場內部來看，利率飆升其實已經造成嚴重衝擊。
彭博報導，儘管標普500指數距離歷史高點不到2%，但從對利率敏感的小型股，到銀行與公用事業類股，都遭遇猛烈拋售。市場中許多投機性的股票，包括尚未獲利的科技公司、以及資產負債表最脆弱的企業，自聯準會(Fed)啟動三年來首度升息之後，表現也落後大盤。
iCapital全球投資策略師Dan Suzuki說：「市場大多數部分至少已較高點下跌5%，更不用說有些市場區塊的跌幅已超過15%。其中很大一部分原因，就是利率走高，以及隨之而來的金融情勢收緊。」
美股市場出現歷史上少見的特殊現象：人工智慧(AI)行情支撐股市表現，但與此同時，市場正處於過去會導致市場劇烈震盪的環境，包括地緣政治風險升高、利率走高，以及美國期中選舉的不確定性。
The Wealth Alliance總裁兼執行董事Eric Diton說：「只要經濟與企業獲利成長維持強勁，股市目前還能承受較高殖利率。」他對股票抱持審慎態度，並買進能源股，以規避債券殖利率與原油價格走高的衝擊。
他表示：「但股市最大的風險，是AI基礎建設出現問題。如果獲利展望遭下修，就會引發更廣泛的股市痛苦。」
以下五個面向揭露股市表面繁榮下隱藏的壓力：

1、等權重標普500持續走弱 市場廣度亮紅燈

標普500等權重指數(S&P 500 Equal Weighted Index)每檔成分股權重相同，目前可能出現連續第七周下跌，重新引發市場對股市廣度過於狹窄的擔憂。換句話說，目前這波多頭行情主要由少數大型股推動。
如果這波弱勢持續至周五，將是等權重標普500指數史上第三次連續7周下跌。根據彭博整理的數據，前兩次分別發生在2002年網路泡沫破裂後，以及2022年熊市拋售期間。
但並非所有人都認為這代表股市多頭行情即將結束，Tallbacken Capital Advisors執行長Michael Purves認為這反映了多頭市場的強勁，以及科技產業的重大顛覆式創新。他對標普500指數年底目標價為8500點，代表還有近11%的上漲空間。

2、小型股遭重擊 羅素2000瀕臨修正

利率與殖利率走高正在衝擊小型企業股，這些公司通常負債較高，業務線也沒那麼多元化。以羅素2000指數(Russell 2000)為例，該指數在剛結束的第3季落後標普500指數將近10個百分點，是1999年以來表現次差。
羅素2000指數目前較8月14日歷史高點下跌8.5%，只差一步就落入修正區。
羅素2000指數的投機性高於大型股同業，金融與工業等景氣敏感型產業，在該指數中的占比較標普500高，而標普500指數則更偏重今年受AI熱潮推動、表現亮眼的科技股。
此外，彭博數據顯示，所謂「殭屍股」——也就是難以、甚至無法支付債務利息的企業——在羅素2000中的占比超過三分之一。

3、銀行股重挫 高借貸成本壓縮獲利展望

儘管美國消費者仍持續支出、企業也持續借款，都有利於銀行業務，但銀行股這幾周以來仍大幅走跌，導致由24家大型銀行組成的KBW那斯達克銀行指數(BKX-US)較8月中旬高點下跌逾12%，遁入修正領域。
KBW那斯達克銀行指數今年迄今上漲3.3%，明顯落後標普500指數12%的漲幅。
借貸成本升高、公債殖利率走高以及信用風險疑慮，都壓縮銀行近期獲利預期。此外，Meta(META-US)代理型AI Mus問世也引發金融股拋售，因為這項技術可能威脅到民眾習慣將現金留在低利率支票帳戶中的行為，也就是所謂的「消費慣性」。
第一資本金融公司(Capital One Financial)(COF-US)、富國銀行(Wells Fargo)(WFC-US)與Huntington Bancshares(HBAN-US)是KBW銀行指數今年表現最差的成分股，跌幅分別為20%、14%與12%。

4、防禦型公用事業也失守 高殖利率削弱股息吸引力

防禦型的公用事業是另一個受到重創的類股，原因在於殖利率走高通常會讓債券相較公用事業股票更具吸引力。
標普500公用事業類股指數自2月歷史高點以來已下跌約17%，正逼近熊市區間。加上市場預期美國天然氣庫存增加，而短天期美債殖利率已高於公用事業通常足以吸引投資人的股息殖利率，都對該產業構成壓力。
10年期美債殖利率第3季大幅上升近1個百分點，創24年新高，標普500公用事業類股則下跌13%。該指數31檔成分股中，僅星座能源(Constellation Energy)(CEG-US)與AES(AES-US)兩家公司上漲。

5、高風險股票反而成為「避險撤退區」

市場中最具投機性的區塊也陷入困境，高盛集團(GS-US)追蹤未盈利一籃子科技公司的指數第3季下跌11%，是該指數同期次差單季表現，成分股包括Roku(ROKU-US)與Peloton(PTON-US)。
另據盛與彭博整理數據，資產負債表最脆弱、負債較高的企業第3季僅上漲1.9%，是2022年初、Fed展開升息循環以來最小的單季漲幅。
不過有一派押注Fed不會再大幅升息。Wealth Consulting Group執行長Jimmy Lee不認為美債殖利率飆升會失控，他表示，投資人只是在拋售對利率敏感的股票，他正以較低的估值買進金融與工業類股。
但他提醒道：「標普500指數最大的風險，是AI行情意外反轉。」
paras_en: US 10-year Treasury yields rose to 5.34% on Thursday (the 1st), a peak not seen since 2002, prompting traders to debate when bond‑market selling might start to weigh more heavily on an otherwise resilient US equity market. From inside the market, the rate spike has already dealt a serious blow.

Bloomberg reports that even though the S&P 500 is less than 2% away from its all‑time high, rate‑sensitive small‑cap stocks as well as banks and utilities have suffered sharp sell‑offs. Many speculative equities—including unprofitable tech firms and companies with the weakest balance sheets—have lagged the broader market since the Fed began its first rate hike in three years.

iCapital global investment strategist Dan Suzuki said, “Most of the market has already fallen at least 5% from its highs, and some sectors are down more than 15%. A large part of that is due to higher rates and the resulting tightening of financial conditions.”

The US equity market is showing a rare historical pattern: AI‑driven rallies are supporting prices, yet at the same time the market is operating in an environment that historically triggers sharp turbulence – heightened geopolitical risk, rising rates and uncertainty around the US mid‑term elections.

Eric Diton, president and managing director of The Wealth Alliance, said, “As long as the economy and corporate earnings keep growing strongly, the market can still tolerate higher yields.” He remains cautious on equities and has added energy stocks to hedge against the impact of higher bond yields and oil prices.
He added, “The biggest risk to the market is a problem with AI infrastructure. If profit outlooks are cut, it could spark broader market pain.”
The following five angles expose the hidden pressures beneath the market’s apparent prosperity:

1. Equal‑weight S&P 500 continues to weaken – market breadth lights up red. The S&P 500 Equal‑Weighted Index, which gives each component the same weight, may be on its seventh consecutive week of decline, reviving concerns that market breadth is too narrow. In other words, the current bull run is being driven mainly by a handful of large‑cap stocks.

If the weakness persists through Friday, it would mark the third time in history the equal‑weight S&P 500 has fallen for seven straight weeks. Bloomberg data show the previous two instances occurred after the 2002 dot‑com bust and during the 2022 bear‑market sell‑off.

Not everyone sees this as a sign that the bull market is ending. Michael Purves, CEO of Tallbacken Capital Advisors, argues it reflects a strong bull market and major disruptive innovation in tech. He targets the S&P 500 at 8,500 points by year‑end, implying roughly 11% upside.

2. Small‑caps take a beating – Russell 2000 on the brink of correction. Higher rates and yields are hitting small‑cap stocks, which typically carry more debt and less diversified businesses. The Russell 2000 lagged the S&P 500 by almost 10 percentage points in Q3, its worst relative performance since 1999.
The Russell 2000 is down 8.5% from its August 14 historic high, just one step away from a correction zone.

Speculative small‑caps are more exposed than large‑cap peers; financials and industrials, which are more cyclical, make up a larger share of the Russell 2000 than of the S&P 500, while the S&P 500 is weighted toward AI‑driven tech stocks that have shone this year.
Bloomberg data also show that “zombie stocks” – companies struggling or unable to service their debt interest – account for more than one‑third of the Russell 2000 constituents.

3. Bank stocks plunge – higher borrowing costs squeeze profit outlooks. Although US consumers keep spending and companies keep borrowing, which should help banks, bank shares have fallen sharply in recent weeks, dragging the KBW Nasdaq Bank Index (BKX‑US), composed of 24 large banks, more than 12% below its mid‑August peak and into correction territory.
The KBW Nasdaq Bank Index is up 3.3% year‑to‑date, still lagging the S&P 500’s 12% gain.

Rising borrowing costs, higher Treasury yields and credit‑risk concerns are compressing banks’ near‑term profit expectations. In addition, Meta’s new generative‑AI model, Mus, sparked a sell‑off in financial stocks because the technology could erode the habit of keeping cash in low‑interest checking accounts – the so‑called “consumption inertia.”
Capital One Financial (COF‑US), Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) and Huntington Bancshares (HBAN‑US) have been the worst performers in the KBX index this year, down 20%, 14% and 12% respectively.
4. Defensive utilities also falter – high yields erode dividend appeal. Defensive utility stocks have been hit hard because rising yields make bonds more attractive than utility equities.

Since its February peak, the S&P 500 Utilities Index has fallen about 17%, edging toward bear‑market territory. Adding to the pressure are expectations of higher US natural‑gas inventories and short‑term Treasury yields that now exceed the dividend yields that usually attract investors to utilities.

10‑year Treasury yields jumped nearly 1 percentage point in Q3, a 24‑year high, while the S&P 500 Utilities Index slid 13%. Of the index’s 31 components, only Constellation Energy (CEG‑US) and AES (AES‑US) posted gains.

5. High‑risk stocks become a “flight‑to‑safety” zone. The most speculative segment of the market is also under strain; Goldman Sachs’ (GS‑US) index of unprofitable tech companies fell 11% in Q3, the worst quarterly performance for that index, which includes stocks such as Roku (ROKU‑US) and Peloton (PTON‑US).
Bloomberg and Goldman data show that the most balance‑sheet‑fragile, highly leveraged firms rose only 1.9% in Q3 – the smallest quarterly gain since early 2022 when the Fed began its rate‑hike cycle.

However, some bet the Fed will not raise rates further. Jimmy Lee, CEO of Wealth Consulting Group, does not think the surge in Treasury yields will get out of control. He says investors are merely selling rate‑sensitive stocks, and he is buying financial and industrial shares at lower valuations.
He cautions, “The biggest risk to the S&P 500 is an unexpected reversal of the AI rally.”

items.title: 把AI搬上桌面！輝達推64GB新機 免靠雲端也能跑模型
items.title_en: Bringing AI to the Desktop! NVIDIA Launches 64GB DGX Spark, Runs Models Locally Without Cloud
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)正將AI代理商機延伸至開發者桌面，周五(2日)宣布10月23日透過合作品牌推出64GB版DGX Spark，售價4,999美元起，讓開發者在自己的設備上執行AI模型與代理。新配置可連接兩台設備擴大運算規模，顯示輝達除了供應大型AI基礎設施，也持續布局本地運算市場。
根據輝達公告，新產品將由宏碁(2353-TW)、華碩(2357-TW)、戴爾(DELL-US)、技嘉(2376-TW)、惠普(HPQ-US)與微星(2377-TW)推出，保留與128GB版本相同的GB10 Grace Blackwell超級晶片、DGX OS及AI軟體平台。

AI代理走向本地運算 硬體與軟體平台同步布局

輝達表示，64GB版本可在設備上執行最多1,000億參數的模型，適用於AI代理、推論、微調與資料科學。開發者可讓程式編寫或研究代理持續運作，處理程式碼審查、文件分析及多步驟任務，無須每項工作都依賴雲端服務。
這項產品的商業意義，在於將AI硬體需求延伸至開發者與研究團隊。隨著模型與代理應用在本地部署，輝達可透過GB10晶片、網路連接及CUDA軟體工具，爭取更多工作流程使用其平台。不過，這是依產品設計觀察的市場機會，公司尚未公布新配置的訂單或出貨預估。
DGX Spark支援Ollama、vLLM及PyTorch等工具，並提供輝達AI代理工具與Nemotron開放模型。月底預計推出的NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher，則將簡化模型下載、啟動與跨設備配置，降低使用者自行設定環境的負擔。
本地運算也讓開發者能在自己的設備上處理資料，對重視隱私或需要持續執行代理的工作具有吸引力。但購買硬體是否比使用雲端更划算，仍取決於使用頻率、模型需求與維護成本。

記憶體容量牽動擴充 售價與實際效能仍是考驗

當模型、上下文長度或同時運作的代理數量增加，記憶體容量就可能成為限制。輝達表示，兩台64GB設備可透過內建ConnectX-7網路連接，合計提供128GB記憶體，支援最多2,000億參數模型。
NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant會偵測連接設備、驗證配置並設定網路，使用者擴充時無須重新建立整套軟體環境。在輝達的Qwen 3.8 27B測試中，兩台64GB設備的效能最高達單台的1.7倍，不過這是針對特定模型的測試結果，不代表執行其他AI任務時，也能達到相同的效能提升。
從記憶體產業角度看，本地AI設備若逐漸普及，可望增加高容量記憶體的應用需求。輝達既有128GB版DGX Spark採用LPDDR5X統一記憶體；新64GB配置的具體供應商與採購規模，則未在這份公告中揭露。
因此，產品推出可視為本地AI市場布局的進展，尚不足以推論特定記憶體業者將大幅受惠。4,999美元起的售價，也意味市場仍須檢驗開發者是否願意投入，以及實際效能能否支持長期使用。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) is extending its AI agent business to developers' desktops, announcing on Friday the October 23 launch of a 64GB version of the DGX Spark starting at $4,999, allowing developers to run AI models and agents on their own hardware. The new configuration can link two devices to scale compute, showing NVIDIA is not only supplying large‑scale AI infrastructure but also continuing to target the local compute market.

According to NVIDIA’s announcement, the new product will be offered by Acer (2353-TW), ASUS (2357-TW), Dell (DELL-US), Gigabyte (2376-TW), HP (HPQ-US) and MSI (2377-TW), and will retain the same GB10 Grace Blackwell super‑chip, DGX OS and AI software platform as the 128GB version.

NVIDIA says the 64GB model can run up to 100 billion‑parameter models on‑device, suitable for AI agents, inference, fine‑tuning and data science. Developers can keep code‑writing or research agents running continuously for tasks such as code review, document analysis and multi‑step workflows without relying on cloud services for every job.

The commercial significance of the product lies in extending AI hardware demand to developers and research teams. As models and agents are deployed locally, NVIDIA can leverage the GB10 chip, network connectivity and CUDA tools to capture more workflow usage of its platform. However, this is a market opportunity inferred from product design; the company has not disclosed order or shipment forecasts for the new configuration.

DGX Spark supports tools such as Ollama, vLLM and PyTorch, and includes NVIDIA AI agent tools and the open Nemotron model. NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher, expected later this month, will simplify model download, launch and cross‑device configuration, reducing the burden of setting up environments manually.

Local compute also lets developers process data on their own machines, which is attractive for privacy‑sensitive work or tasks that require agents to run continuously. Whether buying hardware is more cost‑effective than using the cloud still depends on usage frequency, model requirements and maintenance costs.

Memory capacity becomes a limiting factor as model size, context length or the number of concurrent agents grow. NVIDIA notes that two 64GB units can be linked via built‑in ConnectX‑7 networking to provide a combined 128GB of memory, supporting models up to 200 billion parameters.

NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant detects connected devices, validates configurations and sets up networking, so users can expand without rebuilding the entire software stack. In NVIDIA’s Qwen 3.8 27B benchmark, two 64GB units achieved up to 1.7× the performance of a single unit, though this result applies only to that specific model and does not guarantee similar gains for other AI tasks.

From a memory‑industry perspective, wider adoption of local AI devices could boost demand for high‑capacity memory. NVIDIA’s existing 128GB DGX Spark uses LPDDR5X unified memory; the specific suppliers and procurement scale for the new 64GB configuration were not disclosed in the announcement.

Thus, the product launch marks progress in NVIDIA’s local AI market strategy but is insufficient to conclude that any particular memory vendor will see a major benefit. The starting price of $4,999 also means the market must still test whether developers are willing to invest and whether real‑world performance justifies long‑term use.

items.title: 不只賺上市費！高盛靠客戶早期押注SpaceX 再收數億美元
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Earns More Than IPO Fees: Early Client Bets on SpaceX Yield Hundreds of Millions
paras: 高盛(GS-US)從SpaceX(SPCX-US)今年6月的上市案獲得豐厚收入，但更大的收益來源，是多年前替富裕客戶安排的早期投資。知情人士透露，隨著SpaceX以1.77兆美元估值上市，出售持股的高盛客戶獲利豐厚，也為銀行帶來數億美元績效報酬。
據《彭博》報導，高盛早在五年多前、SpaceX估值僅數百億美元時，就協助客戶投資馬斯克旗下這家公司。高盛合夥人也能與客戶共同投資，意味部分現任及前任高階主管可能同樣獲得可觀收益。高盛發言人拒絕置評。
高盛管理約4兆美元資產的資產與財富管理部門，能替客戶取得少見的未上市公司投資機會。這類投資往往風險較高，但SpaceX案例也凸顯，在企業上市前提早布局的潛在回報。由Kristin Olson領導的富裕客戶另類投資業務，也曾協助客戶參與Stripe與Canva的早期募資。
相較之下，高盛另一部門的投資銀行團隊，擔任SpaceX上市主要顧問，取得約1億美元費用。銀行還曾在紐約總部大廳擺放火箭模型，為上市案造勢。
知情人士表示，這筆未納入財務預估的績效報酬，促使高盛決定提前執行部分慈善捐贈，以提高稅務效率。今年生效的稅制變動，為企業慈善捐款扣除額設立新門檻，只有超過門檻的部分才能享有稅務減免，因而增加集中、提前捐贈的誘因。
執行長蘇德巍(David Solomon)上月已向投資人透露，公司將以「非常具稅務效率」的方式，提前完成數年的慈善捐贈。
他也提醒，這項安排加上科技投資等支出增加，將推高高盛第三季的非薪酬費用。公司預定10月13日公布第三季財報，相關收益與支出的影響屆時將受到關注。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) earned substantial revenue from SpaceX's (SPCX-US) June 2024 IPO, but its larger profit source stems from early‑stage investments arranged for wealthy clients years ago. Sources said that as SpaceX went public with a $1.77 trillion valuation, Goldman’s clients who sold their shares made huge gains, generating performance fees of several hundred million dollars for the bank.

According to Bloomberg, Goldman helped clients invest in Elon Musk’s company more than five years ago when SpaceX was valued at only a few tens of billions. Goldman partners could co‑invest alongside clients, meaning some current and former senior executives may also have realized sizable returns. A Goldman spokesperson declined to comment.

Goldman’s asset and wealth management division, which oversees about $4 trillion in assets, can secure rare private‑company investment opportunities for clients. Such investments are typically higher‑risk, but the SpaceX case highlights the potential upside of getting in before a firm goes public. The alternative‑investment team for affluent clients, led by Kristin Olson, has also helped clients participate in early fundraises for Stripe and Canva.

By contrast, Goldman’s investment‑banking team, which acted as the lead advisor on SpaceX’s IPO, earned roughly $100 million in fees. The bank even displayed a rocket model in the lobby of its New York headquarters to promote the offering.

Sources said the performance fee, which was not included in the firm’s financial forecasts, prompted Goldman to accelerate part of its charitable giving to improve tax efficiency. A tax rule change effective this year set a new threshold for corporate charitable‑donation deductions, allowing tax benefits only for amounts above the threshold, thereby incentivising larger, earlier contributions.
CEO David Solomon told investors last month that the firm would complete several years of charitable donations ahead of schedule in a "highly tax‑efficient" manner.

He also warned that, together with increased spending on technology investments, the arrangement will lift Goldman’s non‑salary expenses in the third quarter. The company plans to release its Q3 earnings on October 13, when the impact of these gains and costs will be closely scrutinised.

items.title: 川普喊韓國投84億美元採油！韓方錯愕：協議裡沒有
items.title_en: Trump Calls for South Korea to Invest $8.4 Billion in Oil Recovery; South Korea Says No Such Clause in Agreement
paras: 美國總統川普周五(2日)宣稱，美韓貿易協議包含一項84億美元的提高原油採收率計畫，但韓方官員隨即表示，該項目並不在協議內。雙方說法落差，再度凸顯川普近期公布的韓國對美投資案，部分內容仍未獲韓方確認。
據《路透》報導，川普在Truth Social發文表示：「與大韓民國的協議愈來愈好！84億美元投入提高原油採收率計畫。生產更多石油與天然氣，意味美國能源主導地位，以及未來全球能源安全！」
不過，《韓聯社》引述韓國產業部官員表示，對這項說法感到意外，並指出協議範圍僅限首爾與華盛頓2025年11月公布的聯合事實清單，未包含該計畫。韓國駐美大使館未能立即聯繫上置評，白宮也未立即回應。
提高原油採收率技術(EOR)常透過向老舊油田注入二氧化碳，採出剩餘原油。大型石油公司支持這項技術，但許多環保團體反對，認為它可能延長對石油的依賴，不能視為氣候解方。
面對選民對美伊戰爭與高汽油價格的疑慮，川普正於11月期中選舉前密集宣傳經濟及投資協議，以強化政績。他周三才宣布，韓國將投資2,000億美元於美國項目，包括八座大型核電廠、天然氣管線及德州一座6GW發電設施。
這是韓國去年貿易協議中，總額3,500億美元戰略投資方案的首批重大項目；整體方案另包含1,500億美元造船投資。
然而，韓方隨即表示，其中540億美元的阿拉斯加液化天然氣(LNG)管線尚未定案，須符合商業與法律條件，並接受可行性及法定程序審查。
該管線也具有政治意義：阿拉斯加共和黨參議員Dan Sullivan正面臨民主黨Mary Peltola的競爭，爭取連任。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 2nd) that the U.S.-South Korea trade deal includes an $8.4 billion plan to boost crude‑oil recovery, but South Korean officials immediately responded that the item is not in the agreement. The discrepancy underscores that parts of Trump’s recently announced South‑Korea‑to‑U.S. investment proposal have not been confirmed by Seoul.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote: “The agreement with the Republic of Korea is getting better and better! $8.4 billion will be put into a plan to increase crude‑oil recovery. Producing more oil and natural gas means U.S. energy dominance and future global energy security!”

However, the Korean Press Agency (Yonhap) quoted a Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy official as saying the statement came as a surprise and noting that the agreement’s scope is limited to the joint fact‑sheet released by Seoul and Washington in November 2025, which does not include such a project. The South Korean embassy in Washington could not be reached for comment, and the White House did not respond immediately.

Enhanced oil recovery (EOR) technology typically involves injecting carbon dioxide into mature fields to extract remaining crude. Large oil majors back the technique, but many environmental groups oppose it, arguing it could prolong reliance on oil and should not be counted as a climate solution.

Facing voter concerns over the U.S.–Iraq war and high gasoline prices, Trump has been intensively promoting economic and investment deals ahead of the November mid‑term elections to bolster his record. He announced on Wednesday that South Korea will invest $200 billion in U.S. projects, including eight large nuclear power plants, natural‑gas pipelines and a 6 GW power facility in Texas.

This is the first batch of major projects under the $350 billion strategic investment package that was part of last year’s trade agreement, which also includes a $150 billion shipbuilding investment component.

South Korean officials, however, said that the $54 billion Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) pipeline has not yet been finalized, must meet commercial and legal conditions, and is subject to feasibility and statutory reviews.
The pipeline also carries political weight: Alaska Republican Senator Dan Sullivan is facing a re‑election challenge from Democrat Mary Peltola, making the project a potential campaign issue.

items.title: 3檔處置股下周一抓去關 準千金股大量遭處置至10/12
items.title_en: Three Stocks to Be Disposed Starting Next Monday, Da Liang Stock Heavily Disposed Until Oct 12
paras: 證交所及櫃買中心今(2)日公告3檔新增處置股，包括上市股大量(3167-TW)、高力(8996-TW)及上櫃生技股浩鼎(4174-TW)等處置股，全數均採2分鐘撮合交易，處置期間皆自下周一(10月5日)起處置到10月12日止。
大量遭處置原因為今日之本益比為68.79，且股價淨值比為20.45。另當日周轉率為7.46%，且其股價淨值比較該類股股價淨值比四倍以上。
高力處置原因為今日本益比為101.68，且股價淨值比為27.42；另今日周轉率為6.26%，且其股價淨值比較該類股股價淨值比四倍以上。
浩鼎處置原因為最近6個營業日(含當日)累積之最後成交價漲幅達36.68%，今日之成交量較最近60個營業日，日平均成交量放大8.81倍。
PCB設備專業廠大量累計今(2026)年1-8月合併營收為71.72億元、年增率達135.15%，受惠高階半導體、PCB設備出貨暢旺。法人預估大量營收有望持續成功創新高，下半年度有望優於上半年。
大量今日在外資、投信連2買支援下，小漲0.62%，盤中一度衝破千元，終場收981元。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market announced today (the 2nd) three newly designated disposal stocks, including listed stock Da Liang (3167-TW), Gao Li (8996-TW), and OTC biotech stock Hao Ding (4174-TW). All will be traded via a 2‑minute matching auction, and the disposal period runs from next Monday (October 5) through October 12.

The reason for Da Liang's disposal is that its price‑earnings ratio today was 68.79 and its price‑to‑book ratio was 20.45. The turnover rate that day was 7.46%, and its price‑to‑book ratio is more than four times the average price‑to‑book ratio of its peer group.

The reason for Gao Li's disposal is that its price‑earnings ratio today was 101.68 and its price‑to‑book ratio was 27.42; the turnover rate was 6.26%, and its price‑to‑book ratio is more than four times that of its peer group.

The reason for Hao Ding's disposal is that over the most recent six trading days (including today) the cumulative increase in the last transaction price reached 36.68%, and today's trading volume was 8.81 times the average daily volume of the past 60 trading days.

PCB equipment specialist Da Liang reported cumulative consolidated revenue of NT$7.172 billion for January–August 2026, a year‑over‑year growth of 135.15%, benefiting from strong shipments of high‑end semiconductors and PCB equipment. Analysts forecast that the robust revenue is likely to continue setting new highs, and the second half of the year is expected to outperform the first half.
Da Liang rose 0.62% today, supported by foreign investors and investment trusts buying in two consecutive sessions; it briefly broke the NT$1,000 mark intraday and closed at NT$981.

items.title: 彭啓明：生物炭成AI與半導體減碳關鍵 將組「台灣隊」拚2030年移除百萬噸碳
items.title_en: Peng Chih-Ming: Biochar is Key to AI and Semiconductor Decarbonization, Forming a “Taiwan Team” to Remove One Million Tons of Carbon by 2030
paras: 環境部長彭啓明於中秋連假期間接受歐洲碳移除專業Podcast節目《The Carbon Removal Scoop》第100集特別節目專訪，向國際社會闡述台灣碳移除戰略。彭啓明宣示，台灣將秉持以終為始精神檢討改進現機制，目標於2030年達成每年100萬噸二氧化碳當量生物炭碳移除（Biochar Carbon Removal）規模。此舉可改善每年500萬噸農業剩餘資材價值，並結合綠色融資與跨國合作，為半導體與AI供應鏈提供高標碳移除方案，成為台灣邁向2050淨零碳排關鍵拼圖。
彭啓明指出，台灣每年產生約500萬噸農業剩餘資材，例如香蕉與鳳梨等作物殘體，過去多以焚化、堆肥處理，未能徹底發揮循環資源價值。為達成2030年百萬噸碳移除目標，環境部正積極與農業部跨部會合作，組成「生物炭台灣隊（Biochar Taiwan Team）」，推動沙盒試驗以加速建立本土方法學。
此外，面對全球半導體與AI供應鏈對高標碳移除迫切需求，生物炭具極高技術與經濟可行性，可望成為我國高科技產業進行綠色轉型關鍵助力。

在制度接軌方面，環境部將參考歐盟碳移除認證框架（CRCF）、歐洲生物炭認證（EBC）、日本農業生物炭策略及歐盟CRCF買方俱樂部（EU CRCF Buyers" Club）等經驗，建構與國際相容認證與交易機制。彭啓明強調，儘管台灣非《聯合國氣候變化綱要公約》締約方，但仍可依《巴黎協定》第6.2條雙邊合作精神積極拓展國際合作，目前我國已與巴拉圭簽署合作備忘錄，未來將於《巴黎協定》框架下共同推動生物炭與森林碳匯等專案，開啟我國參與全球氣候行動新契機。
針對國內具體實績與未來展望，中部已有業者收集科學園區廢木材製作生物炭並取得EBC認證，展現國內民間技術實力。環境部將整合農業部及相關部會並結合民間量能，提出國家級生物炭碳移除計畫，協調金融機構提供綠色融資，並推動生物炭延伸應用於土壤改良、營建材料等，擴大市場需求。
彭啓明表示，生物炭結合農業循環、碳定價與綠色金融，是台灣邁向2050淨零重要拼圖，環境部將持續與各部會及產學研界攜手，讓台灣在全球碳移除市場中扮演關鍵角色。
paras_en: During the Mid‑Autumn holiday, Environment Minister Peng Chih‑Ming was interviewed for the special 100th episode of the European carbon‑removal podcast “The Carbon Removal Scoop,” where he explained Taiwan’s carbon‑removal strategy to the international community. Peng declared that Taiwan will review and improve its current mechanisms with an end‑focused mindset, aiming to achieve an annual biochar carbon‑removal scale of one million tonnes of CO₂‑equivalent by 2030. This would add value to five million tonnes of agricultural residual materials each year, and, combined with green financing and cross‑border cooperation, provide high‑standard carbon‑removal solutions for the semiconductor and AI supply chains, becoming a crucial piece of Taiwan’s path to net‑zero by 2050.

Peng noted that Taiwan generates about five million tonnes of agricultural residuals each year, such as banana and pineapple plant waste, which have traditionally been burned or composted, missing their full circular‑resource potential. To reach the one‑million‑ton carbon‑removal target by 2030, the Ministry of Environment is actively collaborating with the Ministry of Agriculture to form a “Biochar Taiwan Team,” promoting sandbox trials to accelerate the development of domestic methodologies.

He added that, faced with the urgent demand from global semiconductor and AI supply chains for high‑standard carbon removal, biochar offers strong technical and economic feasibility and could become a key driver for the green transformation of Taiwan’s high‑tech industries.

Regarding regulatory alignment, the Ministry will draw on the European Carbon Removal Certification Framework (CRCF), European Biochar Certification (EBC), Japan’s agricultural biochar strategy, and the EU CRCF Buyers’ Club to build internationally compatible certification and trading mechanisms. Peng emphasized that although Taiwan is not a party to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, it can still pursue bilateral cooperation under Article 6.2 of the Paris Agreement. Taiwan has already signed a memorandum of understanding with Paraguay and will jointly promote biochar and forest‑carbon‑sink projects under the Paris Agreement framework, opening new opportunities for global climate action participation.

On domestic achievements and future outlook, a central‑region company has collected waste wood from the science park to produce biochar and obtained EBC certification, showcasing local private‑sector technical strength. The Environment Ministry will integrate efforts from the Agriculture Ministry and other agencies with private‑sector capacity to propose a national biochar carbon‑removal program, coordinate green financing from financial institutions, and promote extended biochar applications such as soil amendment and construction materials to expand market demand.

Peng concluded that combining biochar with agricultural circularity, carbon pricing, and green finance is a vital piece of Taiwan’s journey to net‑zero by 2050. The Environment Ministry will continue to work with other ministries, academia, and industry to ensure Taiwan plays a key role in the global carbon‑removal market.

items.title: 宏捷科9月營收年月雙增 法人估2027年H1獲利有望轉佳
items.title_en: MacroTech's September Revenue Grows Month-over-Month and Year-over-Year; Analysts Expect H1 2027 Profit to Improve
paras: 砷化鎵PA大廠宏捷科(8086-TW)今(2)日公告9月營收為4.21億元、月增0.05%、年增8.4%，第3季合併營收12.6億元、季減3%、年增13%，優於市場原先預期，今(2026)年前3季累計合併營收為37.83億元、年增32.11%。
法人指出，受惠於中國手機市場市占率提升及韓系客戶中高階手機PA轉單效應優於預期，宏捷科第3季營運展現韌性，拉貨動能成為支撐第3季營收的重要來源，隨著第4季進入傳統旺季，訂單需求維持暢旺，全年營收可期。
從宏捷科產品結構觀察，雖然手機相關產品面對2026年整體手機市場需求因記憶體等零組件漲價、缺料衝擊而降溫的負面環境，但持續受惠於中國手機PA廠打入韓國中階手機供應鏈、中國品牌手機高階機種所需PA代工地位穩固，及美國大客戶(IC設計公司)對中、韓旗艦機滲透率開始提高的衍生商機發揮。
此外，在既有PA業務外，宏捷科近年也加快營運轉型，希望降低對單一消費性電子景氣循環的依賴，自去(2024)年下半年起積極開拓光通訊及新興感測市場，包括砷化鎵太陽能產品，目前客戶已正式下單，主要鎖定無人機等特殊應用市場。
據法人報告指出，隨著Wi-Fi相關產品在下半年、看好宏捷科明(2027)年成長動能，包括router Wi-Fi PA訂單數量隨WiFi-7市佔率提高而增加；無人機PA今年上半年營收年增194.6%，客戶家數由1-2家增加至4-5家，後續營收成長性仍高。
在本業PA部分，法人預估下半年宏捷科的毛利率仍受到原材料採購價格偏高影響，待新機種相關產品陸續上市後，預估明年上半年毛利率即有機會回升，獲利展望亦得以轉佳。
paras_en: Gallium arsenide PA major MacroTech (8086-TW) announced today that September revenue was NT$421 million, up 0.05% month‑over‑month and 8.4% year‑over‑year. Consolidated Q3 revenue was NT$1.26 billion, down 3% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 13% year‑over‑year, beating market expectations. For the first three quarters of 2026, cumulative consolidated revenue reached NT$3.783 billion, a 32.11% increase year‑over‑year.

Analysts note that MacroTech benefited from a higher market share in China’s smartphone market and stronger-than‑expected PA order shifts from Korean mid‑to‑high‑end handset customers. The company’s Q3 operations showed resilience, with freight‑pulling momentum becoming a key driver of revenue. As Q4 enters the traditional peak season and order demand remains robust, full‑year revenue looks promising.

Looking at MacroTech’s product mix, although smartphone‑related items face a cooling market in 2026 due to higher component prices and material shortages, the company continues to gain from Chinese PA manufacturers entering the Korean mid‑range handset supply chain, solid PA outsourcing positions for Chinese high‑end phones, and emerging opportunities as a major U.S. IC design customer raises its penetration of Chinese and Korean flagship devices.

Beyond its core PA business, MacroTech has accelerated its operational transformation in recent years to reduce reliance on a single consumer‑electronics cycle. Since the second half of 2024, it has actively pursued optical‑communication and emerging sensor markets, including gallium‑arsenide solar products, for which customers have already placed formal orders, primarily targeting special‑application markets such as drones.

According to the analyst report, Wi‑Fi‑related products are expected to pick up in the second half of the year, and MacroTech’s growth momentum for 2027 looks favorable. Router Wi‑Fi PA order volumes are set to rise as Wi‑Fi 7 market share expands; drone PA revenue grew 194.6% year‑over‑year in the first half of this year, with the customer base expanding from 1‑2 to 4‑5 clients, indicating strong future revenue growth potential.

For its core PA segment, analysts project that MacroTech’s gross margin will remain pressured in the second half of the year due to elevated raw‑material procurement costs. However, as new‑model related products roll out, gross margins are expected to recover in the first half of next year, improving the profit outlook.

items.title: 台積電加碼美國德州？經部表態協助全球布局 但核心技術「根留台灣」
items.title_en: TSMC Expands in Texas? Ministry of Economic Affairs Says It Will Help Global Layout but Core Technology Remains Firmly in Taiwan
paras: 針對媒體報導台積電（2330-TW）（TSM-US）將布局美國德州、擴大對美投資一事，經濟部今（2）日回應表示，台灣半導體產業實力強勁，在全球占據關鍵地位。在面對全球供應鏈韌性需求增加的背景下，政府尊重企業因應國際客戶需求、爭取更大國際商機所進行的全球多元布局。同時強調，台灣依然是全球最重要的半導體生產與研發基地，關鍵前瞻技術仍會堅定根留台灣。
業界傳出，台積電繼先前於美國亞利桑那州推動建廠計畫後，傳出規劃進一步將投資足跡延伸至德州，以深化在美國當地的半導體供應鏈能量。對此，經濟部指出，台積電目前公開宣布赴美投資累積金額為2650億美元，相關具體投資計畫仍以公司向外界說明為宜，經濟部也會持續與台積電保持密切溝通與互動，全力協助企業進行海內外布局並拓展國際市場。
隨著近年全球供應鏈重組壓力增加，半導體製造戰略地位顯著提升，台美兩國在半導體產業的合作也日益緊密。經濟部表示，台美已經簽訂台美投資MOU，進一步強化雙方戰略夥伴關係並加強產業合作，政府未來將針對台灣企業赴美投資提供更強化之協助，以順應國際趨勢並鞏固產業影響力。
經濟部同時強調，企業在布局全球的同時，台灣依然是全球最重要的半導體生產與研發基地，關鍵前瞻技術仍會堅定根留台灣。政府將會盡力協助企業在台灣持續擴大投資，確保台灣在半導體供應鏈中的核心優勢地位與科技實力。
paras_en: In response to media reports that TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) will set up operations in Texas and increase its U.S. investment, the Ministry of Economic Affairs said today that Taiwan’s semiconductor industry is strong and occupies a critical global position. Amid growing demand for supply‑chain resilience, the government respects companies’ decisions to diversify globally to meet international customer needs and capture larger opportunities, while emphasizing that Taiwan remains the world’s most important semiconductor manufacturing and R&D hub and that key forward‑looking technologies will stay firmly rooted in Taiwan.

Industry sources say that after TSMC’s earlier plant project in Arizona, the company is planning to extend its investment footprint to Texas to deepen its semiconductor supply‑chain presence in the United States. The ministry noted that TSMC has publicly announced cumulative U.S. investments of $265 billion, and that specific project details should be provided by the company itself. The ministry will continue close communication with TSMC and fully support the firm’s overseas and domestic layout and market expansion.

With increasing pressure to restructure global supply chains, the strategic importance of semiconductor manufacturing has risen sharply, and Taiwan‑U.S. cooperation in the sector is becoming ever tighter. The ministry said Taiwan and the United States have signed a Taiwan‑U.S. investment MOU to further strengthen their strategic partnership and industry collaboration, and that the government will enhance assistance for Taiwanese firms investing in the U.S. to align with global trends and consolidate industry influence.

The ministry also stressed that while companies expand globally, Taiwan remains the world’s most important semiconductor manufacturing and R&D base, and that key forward‑looking technologies will stay firmly rooted in Taiwan. The government will do its utmost to help firms continue expanding investment in Taiwan, ensuring the island’s core advantage and technological strength in the semiconductor supply chain.

items.title: 北市12家企業參展新加坡科技周聚焦AI 估促成3105萬美元潛在商機
items.title_en: Taipei City’s 12 Companies Exhibit at Singapore Tech Week, Focusing on AI, Forecast to Generate $31.05 Million in Potential Business
paras: 台北市產發局近日率12家企業於「2026新加坡科技周」大放異彩，以「Smart Tech．Innovative Taipei」設置「台北主題館」，鎖定新加坡數位轉型浪潮下的市場需求，聚焦AI多元應用，展現北市企業從運算設備、資料治理到終端應用的AI軟硬整合實力，在2日展期中，預估促成逾3,105萬美元潛在商機，促進台星雙方產業交流與合作。
協辦單位外貿協會表示，本次台北主題館依技術鏈與應用需求，規劃「智慧運算與感知」、「資料治理與安全」及「智慧應用與服務」三大展示面向，呈現AI技術在企業營運、資訊安全、商務服務及人才培訓等領域的應用。
透過展前買主邀約精準瞭解市場需求，提前安排洽談對焦接觸潛在合作夥伴；現場到訪買主則由台北主題館工作人員及導覽人員依其需求，媒合引介至相關企業展台，館內並設置開放式洽談桌，提供買主與參展企業充分交流互動的空間，也安排多場媒合洽談會、貴賓導覽及媒體採訪，並邀請當地企業代表及重要公協會交流，協助建立在地商脈、掌握新加坡市場商業模式。
在展場交流方面，光影立方與海外零售通路業者就裸眼3D視覺解決方案進行洽談，並簽訂星馬地區代理合作，後續將持續拓展其他市場；輔信(2405-TW)科技亦與多家潛在客戶及合作夥伴交流，其中與新加坡AI解決方案業者就邊緣AI工業電腦、大型語言模型優化及AI Agent(AI代理人)等應用需求交換意見，後續將持續洽談合作可能性。

展會期間，參展企業亦受邀參與大會發表活動，分享創新技術與應用方案，展現AI產業鏈的國際競爭力與創新能量。皓博科技以「AI-Ready Data Pipelines – From Raw Data to Actionable Insights」為題發表，與可口可樂、Google Cloud的代表，交流如何運用AI分析資料、取得可供應用的洞察；以力、愛比科技、核桃運算及光影立方則參與「Reimagining Work with AI by Our Side」主題發表，愛比科技邀請現場觀眾體驗AI即時語音翻譯，呈現企業在資料應用與AI工作場域的不同解決方案。
產發局表示，新加坡是台北企業鏈結東南亞市場的關鍵節點，去(2025)年初次參加新加坡科技周即促成約2,500萬美元的潛在商機，今年更深耕突破，展後將持續追蹤參展企業的洽談情形與合作需求，並彙整商機開發、通路拓展及技術合作等成果，協助企業推進跨國合作機會，帶動城市經濟與產業競爭力成長。
paras_en: The Taipei City Economic Development Bureau recently led 12 companies to shine at the 2026 Singapore Tech Week, setting up a "Smart Tech·Innovative Taipei" Taipei Pavilion. Targeting market demand amid Singapore’s digital‑transformation wave, the pavilion highlighted diverse AI applications and showcased the city’s AI hardware‑software integration capabilities—from computing equipment and data governance to end‑user solutions. Over the two‑day exhibition, it is estimated to generate more than US$31.05 million in potential business, fostering industry exchange and cooperation between Taiwan and Singapore.

Co‑organiser the Taiwan External Trade Development Council said the Taipei Pavilion was organized around three major showcase themes—"Intelligent Computing and Sensing," "Data Governance and Security," and "Intelligent Applications and Services"—to demonstrate AI’s use in corporate operations, information security, business services and talent training.

By pre‑event buyer invitations, market needs were precisely identified and meetings were scheduled in advance to connect with potential partners. On‑site, pavilion staff and guides matched visiting buyers with relevant exhibitor booths based on their needs; an open‑talking area was provided for extensive interaction, and multiple matchmaking sessions, VIP tours and media interviews were arranged. Local company representatives and key industry associations were also invited to help build local networks and understand Singapore’s business models.

During the exhibition, LightCube and an overseas retail channel operator discussed a naked‑eye 3D visual solution and signed an agency agreement for the Singapore‑Malaysia region, with plans to expand to other markets. Fu‑Xin Technology (2405‑TW) also engaged with several prospective customers and partners, exchanging views with a Singapore AI solutions provider on edge‑AI industrial PCs, large‑language‑model optimization and AI agents, and will continue to explore cooperation possibilities.

Throughout the show, participating companies were invited to present at conference sessions, sharing innovative technologies and solutions that highlight the international competitiveness and creative energy of the AI value chain. HaoBo Technology presented “AI‑Ready Data Pipelines – From Raw Data to Actionable Insights,” discussing with representatives from Coca‑Cola and Google Cloud how to use AI for data analysis and actionable insights. Li‑Force, Aibi Technology, Walnut Computing and LightCube took part in the “Reimagining Work with AI by Our Side” session, with Aibi Technology offering live AI‑powered speech translation to showcase varied solutions for data use and AI‑enabled workplaces.

The Economic Development Bureau noted that Singapore is a key gateway for Taipei firms to reach Southeast Asian markets. The city’s first participation in Singapore Tech Week in early 2025 generated roughly US$25 million in potential business; this year’s deeper engagement is expected to yield even more. After the exhibition, the bureau will continue to monitor negotiations and cooperation needs, compile outcomes in business development, channel expansion and technology collaboration, and help firms advance cross‑border opportunities, driving growth in the city’s economy and industrial competitiveness.

items.title: 惠民旗下惠嘉水務奪「嘉義縣擴大縣治再生水廠BTO案」投資16.9億元
items.title_en: Huimin's subsidiary Huijia Water Wins "Chiayi County Expanded County Seat Recycled Water Plant BTO Project" with a NT$1.69 billion investment
paras: 環工、水務廠商惠民實業 (6971-TW) 旗下子公司惠嘉水務今 (2) 日公布拿下「嘉義縣擴大縣治再生水廠BTO案」，將採取(Build-Transfer-Operate，BTO)的興建-移轉-營運模式，預計投資金額16.9億元。
環工廠商惠民實業旗下子公司惠嘉水務拿下的此一再生水務BTO工程案，預計興建期為1195日曆天，營運期自營運開始日起算15年。
惠民指出，惠嘉應依投資契約約定期限完成相關設施的興建及營運，並提供興建期及營運期履約保證金，履行相關營運管理、水質標準、設備維護及資產轉移等義務。
惠民目前股本約 3.87 億元，惠民實業主要業務為水資源及廢棄物處理，水資源包含公共污水處理廠、再生水、海水淡化及淨水場，也包含近期受社會關注的水利工程，如抽水站、滯洪池等，這些水資源處理惠民實業提供操作維護以及興建、更新及工程承攬等服務。
而日前欣陸投控(3703-TW)旗下欣達環工也宣布，正式獲評為「新竹市客雅水資源回收中心放流水回收再利用BTO案」最優申請人，並已完成議約程序。本案預估投資金額約84.5億元，興建及特許期合計約18年6個月，建置再生水系統後，每日供應寶山二期園區4萬噸再生水。
欣陸投控指出，「新竹市客雅水資源回收中心放流水回收再利用BTO案」，採BTO，興建、移轉及營運）模式推動，主要包括客雅水資源回收中心污水處理廠擴建工程、再生水廠新建工程，以及相關取輸水與輸配水設施。完工後污水處理廠整體處理能力達70,000 CMD；再生水系統每日可供應4萬噸再生水，主要供應寶山二期園區使用。
paras_en: Environmental engineering and water services company Huimin Industrial (6971‑TW) announced today that its subsidiary Huijia Water has secured the "Chiayi County Expanded County Seat Recycled Water Plant BTO Project," which will use a Build‑Transfer‑Operate (BTO) model and is expected to involve an investment of NT$1.69 billion.

The recycled‑water BTO project won by Huijia Water, a subsidiary of Huimin Industrial, is slated for a construction period of 1,195 calendar days, followed by a 15‑year operating term counted from the start of operations.

Huimin stated that Huijia must complete the construction and operation of the related facilities within the contractually agreed timeframe, provide performance guarantees for both the construction and operation phases, and fulfill obligations related to operational management, water‑quality standards, equipment maintenance, and asset transfer.

Huimin currently has a share capital of about NT$387 million. Its core business covers water resources and waste‑treatment services, including public sewage treatment plants, reclaimed water, seawater desalination, and drinking‑water facilities, as well as water‑infrastructure projects that have recently drawn public attention such as pumping stations and detention ponds. Huimin provides operation‑maintenance, construction, upgrade and engineering contracting services for these water‑resource projects.

Earlier, Xinlu Investment Holding (3703‑TW) subsidiary XinDa Environmental Engineering announced that it had been formally selected as the top applicant for the "Hsinchu City Ke‑Ya Water‑Resource Recovery Center Effluent Recycling and Reuse BTO Project" and has completed the contract‑signing process. The project is estimated to require an investment of about NT$8.45 billion, with a combined construction and concession period of roughly 18 years and 6 months, and will supply 40,000 tons of reclaimed water per day to the Baoshan Phase‑II industrial park after the system is built.

Xinlu Investment Holding explained that the "Hsinchu City Ke‑Ya Water‑Resource Recovery Center Effluent Recycling and Reuse BTO Project" follows a BTO (build, transfer, operate) approach, encompassing the expansion of the Ke‑Ya water‑resource recovery center sewage‑treatment plant, the construction of a new reclaimed‑water plant, and related water‑intake, transmission and distribution facilities. Upon completion, the sewage‑treatment plant will have a total capacity of 70,000 cubic meters per day, and the reclaimed‑water system will be able to supply 40,000 tons of reclaimed water daily, primarily for the Baoshan Phase‑II park.

items.title: 鴻海攜手祥寶參展台北國際照顧博覽會 智慧長照三大場域啟動實證
items.title_en: Foxconn Partners with Xiangbao to Exhibit at Taipei International Care Expo, Launching Three Smart Long-Term Care Pilot Sites
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)與祥寶尊榮長照集團於Cares Expo Taipei 2026台北國際照顧博覽會展出智慧長照合作成果，雙方於桃園寶之林、太原祥寶及怡德日照中心三大場域進行實證，驗證AI與健康數據融入日常照護流程的可行性。
雙方自2025年11月起推動智慧長照合作，導入智慧穿戴、AI運算、端雲整合及人機協作等技術，並合作重點並非單純導入智慧設備，而是從實際照護流程出發，觀察長者、照護人員及系統平台的使用需求，檢視健康數據與照護流程的串聯方式，並將場域累積的經驗作為後續產品及服務優化依據，逐步建立以數據、AI及人機協作為基礎的智慧長照模式。
在長者端，智慧穿戴讓健康管理從照護人員監測，逐步增加長者自主參與；在照護端，則透過個人化監測、異常資訊上報及數據整合，協助照護人員掌握長者狀況，讓AI支援照護工作，建立「Human + AI」人機協作模式。
此次展會現場也展示雙方智慧照護成果，包括CoDoctor Pro、CoDoctor Home、CoDoctor Watch及Nurabot護理協作機器人等，涵蓋智慧穿戴、軟硬體整合及端雲平台應用，從單一產品逐步走向整合型智慧長照解決方案。
祥寶尊榮長照集團今年適逢深耕長照40週年，並於展覽首日舉行40週年慶典暨開幕儀式，祥寶董事長林哲弘表示，真正的AI-Native Long Care並不是把AI放進長照，而是重新思考長照如何運作。未來祥寶將持續與鴻海深化合作，在更多長照場域累積實證經驗，推動智慧科技由單一產品走向平台解決方案，朝智慧醫養及AI原生長照發展。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317-TW) and Xiangbao Premium Long-Term Care Group showcased their smart long‑term care collaboration at Cares Expo Taipei 2026, demonstrating results from three pilot sites—Taoyuan Baozhilin, Taiyuan Xiangbao, and Yide Daycare Center—where they validated the feasibility of integrating AI and health data into everyday care processes.

Since November 2025, the two parties have been advancing a smart long‑term care partnership that introduces smart wearables, AI computing, edge‑cloud integration and human‑machine collaboration. The focus is not merely on deploying smart devices but on starting from actual care workflows, observing the needs of seniors, caregivers and the platform, examining how health data links with care processes, and using the accumulated field experience to refine future products and services, gradually building a data‑, AI‑ and human‑machine‑collaboration‑based smart care model.

For seniors, smart wearables shift health management from caregiver monitoring toward greater self‑participation; for caregivers, personalized monitoring, abnormal alerts and data integration help them keep track of seniors’ conditions, allowing AI to support caregiving and establishing a “Human + AI” collaboration model.

The expo also displayed the partners’ smart care achievements, including CoDoctor Pro, CoDoctor Home, CoDoctor Watch and the Nurabot nursing collaboration robot, covering smart wearables, hardware‑software integration and edge‑cloud platform applications, moving from single products toward integrated smart long‑term care solutions.

This year marks Xiangbao Premium Long‑Term Care Group’s 40th anniversary of deep involvement in long‑term care. On the opening day of the exhibition, a 40‑year celebration and ceremony were held. Chairman Lin Zhe‑hong said that true AI‑Native Long Care is not about merely inserting AI into care, but rethinking how care operates. Xiangbao will continue to deepen cooperation with Foxconn, gather more field evidence across additional care sites, and advance smart technology from isolated products to platform solutions, driving development toward smart medical‑nursing and AI‑native long‑term care.

items.title: 聚陽Q3營收創近6季最佳 累計營收重返正成長 Q4可望維持年增
items.title_en: Juyang Q3 Revenue Hits Best in Nearly Six Quarters, Cumulative Revenue Returns to Positive Growth; Q4 Expected to Maintain Year-over-Year Increase
paras: 成衣代工大廠聚陽(1477-TW)今(2)日公告9月營收29.3億元，月減17.5%、年增24%；第三季營收94.84億元，創近6季最佳，季增16.1%、年增6.7%；累計前9月營收265.46億元，年增0.2%，重返成長軌道。
聚陽表示，第三季營收表現符合公司預期，回到個位數年增；展望第四季，雖然戰爭未解、高油價及通膨等外部不確定因素仍在，但目前訂單能見度仍達年底，預計第四季業績可望維持年增表現，全年維持較去年成長的目標。
聚陽進一步指出，目前運動盤需求穩健，除了產品單價較高、毛利率較佳，客戶也陸續下急單，並進一步推升價格；隨著第四季至明年第一季進入運動盤傳統旺季，可望帶動營收表現。目前運動盤營收比重約5成，旺季可能提升至6成。
展望明年，聚陽持相對正向看法，主要是美國期中選舉落幕、戰爭因素也可望淡化，隨著負面因素影響逐漸消退，有助提振市場信心；另一方面，AI快速崛起，具備快速反應及彈性的供應商也較具優勢，這也是聚陽的強項。
paras_en: Garment OEM giant Juyang (1477-TW) announced today (2) September revenue of NT$2.93 billion, down 17.5% month‑on‑month, up 24% year‑on‑year; third‑quarter revenue of NT$9.484 billion, the best in almost six quarters, up 16.1% sequentially and 6.7% year‑on‑year; cumulative revenue for the first nine months of NT$26.546 billion, up 0.2% year‑on‑year, returning to growth.

Juyang said the Q3 revenue performance met company expectations, returning to single‑digit year‑over‑year growth; looking ahead to Q4, although external uncertainties such as the unresolved war, high oil prices and inflation remain, order visibility still extends to year‑end, and the company expects Q4 results to maintain year‑over‑year growth, keeping the full‑year growth target over last year.

Juyang further noted that demand for sports plates remains solid; besides higher product prices and better gross margins, customers are also placing urgent orders and further pushing up prices; with Q4 through Q1 of next year entering the traditional peak season for sports plates, revenue performance is expected to be boosted. Currently, sports‑plate revenue accounts for about 50% of total, which could rise to 60% in the peak season.

Looking to next year, Juyang remains relatively optimistic, mainly because the U.S. midterm elections have concluded and war‑related factors are expected to ease; as negative influences gradually recede, market confidence should improve. Moreover, the rapid rise of AI gives an edge to suppliers that can respond quickly and flexibly, which is a strength of Juyang.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉非農爆冷！降息預期激勵美股收紅 那指周線喜提連三紅
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: Cold Nonfarm Payrolls Boosted Markets, Nasdaq Posts Third Consecutive Weekly Gain
paras: 美國 9 月非農就業報告顯著降溫，市場對聯準會可能升息的預期降溫，激勵美股三大指數週五 (2 日) 全面收紅。科技股為衝鋒主力，那指盤中一度飆上新高，終場收漲 1.19% 至 27,190.86 點，距離 9 月 22 日創下的歷史高點 (27,244.28 點) 僅差不到 0.2%。
總經數據方面，美國勞工部公布 9 月非農就業僅新增 2.9 萬人，遠低於市場預期的 8.4 萬人，前兩個月的就業數據亦遭到下修；失業率則受勞動參與率提升影響，由 4.1% 略升至 4.2%，平均時薪增幅則同步放緩。
這份弱於預期的就業數據，促使投資人重新評估 Fed 的貨幣政策走向。芝商所 (CME) FedWatch 工具顯示，市場預期 Fed 在 10 月會議降息或維持利率不變的押注顯著升溫，政策緊縮壓力大為減輕。
股市表現方面，AI 巨頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 盤中再創歷史新高，超微 (AMD-US) 與資安族群同步強勢走揚，推升那斯達克 100 指數刷新紀錄。加密貨幣概念股早盤受比特幣重返 86,000 美元關卡激勵躍升，唯隨後走勢分化。
此外，七大工業國集團 (G7) 釋出可能動用緊急戰略準備的訊號後，西德州原油 (WTI) 期貨重挫 1.5% 至每桶 91.48 美元，油價顯著回落進一步撫平市場恐慌情緒。
不過，美債市場走勢出現波動。指標性的美國 10 年期公債殖利率在報告公布初時一度急挫，但隨後逆勢轉升約 4 個基點至 5.28%，壓抑了美股尾盤的漲幅。
分析指出，債市除了反映物價黏性與政府擴大財政支出外，科技巨頭為擴建 AI 基礎設施而大量發債，亦對市場流動性帶來壓力。
美股週五 (2 日) 主要指數表現：

道瓊工業指數上漲 250.40 點，或 0.49%，報 51,176.96 點。
那斯達克指數上漲 319.27 點，或 1.19%，報 27,190.86 點。
S&P 500 指數上漲 56.27 點，或 0.73%，報 7,722.72 點。
費城半導體指數上漲 307.68 點，或 2.40%，報 13,136.68 點。
NYSE FANG+ 指數上漲 106.87 點，或 0.56%，報 19,211.64 點。


週線表現部分，儘管道瓊與標普本週分別累跌 1.26% 與 0.27%，但那斯達克指數展現韌性，本週逆勢上揚 0.45%，締造連續第 3 週收升紀錄。
焦點個股
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭集體攀揚。Meta (META-US) 上漲 0.30%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.02%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 1.56%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.92%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 1.33%。
半導體主要個股普遍走高。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 2.95%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 3.35%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 1.34%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 2.03%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.53%。
記憶體與儲存族群多數下挫。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 2.05%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 重挫 10.22%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 3.79%；希捷 (STX-US) 重挫 10.21%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 0.84%。
台股 ADR 全紅。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 2.96%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 大漲 6.08%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 4.20%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 1.34%。
企業新聞
輝達 (NVDA-US) 收高 1.34%，收在 233.95 美元，逼近歷史收盤高點。輝達先前於 5 月 14 日創下 235.74 美元的收盤紀錄。公司近日將股票回購計畫額度增加 1,500 億美元，創史上最大規模。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 勁揚 4.65% 至每股 370.59 美元。這家電動車大廠第三季交車 486,532 輛，較第二季增加 1%，較去年同期減少 2%，但仍大幅優於華爾街預期。
Rivian (RIVN-US) 第三季交車 19,248 輛，高於市場預估的 18,001 輛，股價仍收黑 3.1% 至每股 14.30 美元。
安森美半導體 (ON-US) 飛升 6.01%。Synaptics (SYNA-US) 狂飆超 14%。安森美半導體同意以 57 億美元現金收購 Synaptics ，取代先前價值 70 億美元的股票交易方案。
Nike (NKE-US) 週五跌幅超 3.5%。公司第一季營收未達華爾街預期，並提出疲弱的全年財測，顯示營運轉型仍面臨挑戰。
慧與科技 (HPE-US) 噴高 7.36%，名列標普指數漲幅最大的成分股之一。慧與表示，AI 需求可望帶動網路業務營收穩健成長。
《日經》報導，東芝計劃投資 3.8 億美元擴建菲律賓廠區，將資料中心用硬碟 (HDD) 產能提高至目前的 2 倍。消息衝擊同業股價，希捷科技 (STX-US) 下殺 10.21%，威騰電子 (WDC-US) 也狂瀉 10%。
莫德納 (MRNA-US) 上漲約 0.6%。那斯達克交易所宣布，公司將於 10 月 9 日開盤前取代華納兄弟探索 (WBD-US)，納入那斯達克 100 指數。華納兄弟探索預計下週完成與 Paramount Skydance 的合併。
華爾街分析
Nuveen 投資長 Saira Malik 認為，非農就業報告可望在財報季啟動前支撐市場，並預期接下來的企業獲利表現將相當強勁。
不過，eToro 分析師 Bret Kenwell 提醒，疲弱就業數據可能再次帶動「壞消息就是好消息」的交易邏輯，但若勞動市場明顯惡化，將為經濟帶來另一項挑戰。他指出，10 年期美債殖利率的 5% 關卡值得關注，若成為新的低檔支撐，股市能否持續承受高利率將受到考驗。
Edward Jones 策略師 Angelo Kourkafas 則表示，最新數據顯示勞動市場正在降溫，但基本面仍健康。儘管高利率與地緣政治不確定性可能壓抑估值、加劇波動，持續擴張的經濟與穩健的企業獲利成長，仍可望支撐美股今年剩餘時間的表現。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: U.S. September nonfarm payrolls cooled sharply, easing market expectations of further Fed rate hikes and prompting all three major U.S. equity indexes to close higher on Friday (the 2nd). Tech stocks led the rally, with the Nasdaq soaring to a new intraday high before finishing up 1.19% at 27,190.86 points, just under 0.2% shy of the September 22 record peak of 27,244.28 points.

On the macro side, the Labor Department reported that September added only 29,000 jobs, far below the 84,000 forecast, and the figures for the prior two months were also revised down. The unemployment rate ticked up slightly from 4.1% to 4.2% as labor‑force participation rose, while average hourly earnings growth slowed.

The weaker‑than‑expected payrolls led investors to reassess the Fed’s policy path. CME’s FedWatch tool shows a sharp rise in bets that the Fed will either cut rates or hold them steady at the October meeting, easing tightening pressure considerably.

In equities, AI heavyweight Nvidia (NVDA-US) hit another all‑time high during the session, while AMD and cybersecurity stocks surged, pushing the Nasdaq‑100 to a fresh record. Crypto‑related stocks jumped early after Bitcoin reclaimed the $86,000 level, but later showed mixed performance.

In addition, after the G7 signaled it might tap emergency strategic reserves, West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures fell 1.5% to $91.48 a barrel, pulling oil prices down and calming market panic.

U.S. Treasury markets were volatile. The benchmark 10‑year yield plunged sharply right after the report’s release, then rebounded about four basis points to 5.28%, tempering the equity rally in the closing minutes.

Analysts note that the bond market reflects not only sticky inflation and expanded fiscal spending but also heavy issuance by tech giants financing AI infrastructure, which pressures market liquidity.
U.S. equity performance on Friday (the 2nd):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 250.40 points, or 0.49%, to 51,176.96. The Nasdaq Composite gained 319.27 points, or 1.19%, to 27,190.86. The S&P 500 climbed 56.27 points, or 0.73%, to 7,722.72. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 307.68 points, or 2.40%, to 13,136.68. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 106.87 points, or 0.56%, to 19,211.64.  On the weekly chart, although the Dow and S&P fell 1.26% and 0.27% respectively this week, the Nasdaq showed resilience, gaining 0.45% and marking its third straight week of advances.
Focus stocks

The five big tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index all moved higher: Meta (META‑US) up 0.30%, Apple (AAPL‑US) up 1.02%, Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) up 1.56%, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) up 0.92% and Amazon (AMZN‑US) up 1.33%.
Semiconductor leaders also rose: AMD (AMD‑US) up 2.95%, Broadcom (AVGO‑US) up 3.35%, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) up 1.34%, Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) up 2.03% and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) up 1.53%.

Memory and storage stocks mostly fell: Micron (MU‑US) down 2.05%, Western Digital (WDC‑US) plunged 10.22%, SanDisk (SNDK‑US) down 3.79%, Seagate (STX‑US) down 10.21%, while SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) rose 0.84%.
All Taiwan‑related ADRs were up: TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) up 2.96%, ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) surged 6.08%, UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 4.20% and Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) up 1.34%.
Company news
Nvidia (NVDA‑US) closed up 1.34% at $233.95, near its all‑time closing high of $235.74 set on May 14. The company recently expanded its share‑repurchase program by $150 billion, the largest ever.
Tesla (TSLA‑US) jumped 4.65% to $370.59. The automaker delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3, a 1% increase from Q2 but a 2% decline year‑over‑year, still far ahead of Wall Street forecasts.
Rivian (RIVN‑US) delivered 19,248 vehicles in Q3, beating the consensus estimate of 18,001, yet the stock closed down 3.1% at $14.30.

ON Semiconductor (ON‑US) surged 6.01% and Synaptics (SYNA‑US) rocketed more than 14% after ON agreed to acquire Synaptics for $5.7 billion in cash, replacing an earlier $7 billion stock‑swap proposal.

Nike (NKE‑US) fell more than 3.5% on Friday after first‑quarter revenue missed Wall Street expectations and the company issued a weak full‑year outlook, signaling ongoing challenges in its transformation plan.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) jumped 7.36%, making it one of the biggest gainers in the S&P 500. The firm said rising AI demand should drive solid growth in its networking revenue.

According to the Nikkei, Toshiba plans to invest $380 million to expand its Philippine plant, doubling HDD capacity for data‑center use. The news sent peers tumbling, with Seagate (STX‑US) down 10.21% and Western Digital (WDC‑US) plunging 10%.

Moderna (MRNA‑US) rose about 0.6% after Nasdaq announced that the company will replace Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD‑US) in the Nasdaq‑100 effective before the opening on October 9. Warner Bros. Discovery is expected to complete its merger with Paramount Skydance next week.
Wall Street commentary
Nuveen Chief Investment Officer Saira Malik said the payroll report should help support markets ahead of earnings season and expects corporate earnings to remain robust.

However, eToro analyst Bret Kenwell warned that weak jobs data could revive the “bad news is good news” trade, but a clearly deteriorating labor market would pose a new economic challenge. He highlighted the 5% level on the 10‑year Treasury as a key support to watch; if it holds, the equity market’s ability to endure high rates will be tested.

Edward Jones strategist Angelo Kourkafas noted that the latest data show the labor market cooling while fundamentals stay healthy. Although high rates and geopolitical uncertainty may suppress valuations and increase volatility, a still‑expanding economy and solid corporate profit growth should underpin U.S. equities for the rest of the year.
