items.title: AI獨撐美股大盤！美債殖利率飆高股市表面淡定 5大面向暴露內部壓力
items.title_en: AI Propels US Stock Market While Treasury Yields Surge; Stock Market Appears Calm but Five Areas Reveal Internal Pressure
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率周四(1日)一度升至5.34%，創2002年以來新高後，股票交易員正熱烈討論，債市拋售何時會開始對韌性十足的美股造成更大壓力。但從市場內部來看，利率飆升其實已經造成嚴重衝擊。
彭博報導，儘管標普500指數距離歷史高點不到2%，但從對利率敏感的小型股，到銀行與公用事業類股，都遭遇猛烈拋售。市場中許多投機性的股票，包括尚未獲利的科技公司、以及資產負債表最脆弱的企業，自聯準會(Fed)啟動三年來首度升息之後，表現也落後大盤。
iCapital全球投資策略師Dan Suzuki說：「市場大多數部分至少已較高點下跌5%，更不用說有些市場區塊的跌幅已超過15%。其中很大一部分原因，就是利率走高，以及隨之而來的金融情勢收緊。」
美股市場出現歷史上少見的特殊現象：人工智慧(AI)行情支撐股市表現，但與此同時，市場正處於過去會導致市場劇烈震盪的環境，包括地緣政治風險升高、利率走高，以及美國期中選舉的不確定性。
The Wealth Alliance總裁兼執行董事Eric Diton說：「只要經濟與企業獲利成長維持強勁，股市目前還能承受較高殖利率。」他對股票抱持審慎態度，並買進能源股，以規避債券殖利率與原油價格走高的衝擊。
他表示：「但股市最大的風險，是AI基礎建設出現問題。如果獲利展望遭下修，就會引發更廣泛的股市痛苦。」
以下五個面向揭露股市表面繁榮下隱藏的壓力：

1、等權重標普500持續走弱 市場廣度亮紅燈

標普500等權重指數(S&P 500 Equal Weighted Index)每檔成分股權重相同，目前可能出現連續第七周下跌，重新引發市場對股市廣度過於狹窄的擔憂。換句話說，目前這波多頭行情主要由少數大型股推動。
如果這波弱勢持續至周五，將是等權重標普500指數史上第三次連續7周下跌。根據彭博整理的數據，前兩次分別發生在2002年網路泡沫破裂後，以及2022年熊市拋售期間。
但並非所有人都認為這代表股市多頭行情即將結束，Tallbacken Capital Advisors執行長Michael Purves認為這反映了多頭市場的強勁，以及科技產業的重大顛覆式創新。他對標普500指數年底目標價為8500點，代表還有近11%的上漲空間。

2、小型股遭重擊 羅素2000瀕臨修正

利率與殖利率走高正在衝擊小型企業股，這些公司通常負債較高，業務線也沒那麼多元化。以羅素2000指數(Russell 2000)為例，該指數在剛結束的第3季落後標普500指數將近10個百分點，是1999年以來表現次差。
羅素2000指數目前較8月14日歷史高點下跌8.5%，只差一步就落入修正區。
羅素2000指數的投機性高於大型股同業，金融與工業等景氣敏感型產業，在該指數中的占比較標普500高，而標普500指數則更偏重今年受AI熱潮推動、表現亮眼的科技股。
此外，彭博數據顯示，所謂「殭屍股」——也就是難以、甚至無法支付債務利息的企業——在羅素2000中的占比超過三分之一。

3、銀行股重挫 高借貸成本壓縮獲利展望

儘管美國消費者仍持續支出、企業也持續借款，都有利於銀行業務，但銀行股這幾周以來仍大幅走跌，導致由24家大型銀行組成的KBW那斯達克銀行指數(BKX-US)較8月中旬高點下跌逾12%，遁入修正領域。
KBW那斯達克銀行指數今年迄今上漲3.3%，明顯落後標普500指數12%的漲幅。
借貸成本升高、公債殖利率走高以及信用風險疑慮，都壓縮銀行近期獲利預期。此外，Meta(META-US)代理型AI Mus問世也引發金融股拋售，因為這項技術可能威脅到民眾習慣將現金留在低利率支票帳戶中的行為，也就是所謂的「消費慣性」。
第一資本金融公司(Capital One Financial)(COF-US)、富國銀行(Wells Fargo)(WFC-US)與Huntington Bancshares(HBAN-US)是KBW銀行指數今年表現最差的成分股，跌幅分別為20%、14%與12%。

4、防禦型公用事業也失守 高殖利率削弱股息吸引力

防禦型的公用事業是另一個受到重創的類股，原因在於殖利率走高通常會讓債券相較公用事業股票更具吸引力。
標普500公用事業類股指數自2月歷史高點以來已下跌約17%，正逼近熊市區間。加上市場預期美國天然氣庫存增加，而短天期美債殖利率已高於公用事業通常足以吸引投資人的股息殖利率，都對該產業構成壓力。
10年期美債殖利率第3季大幅上升近1個百分點，創24年新高，標普500公用事業類股則下跌13%。該指數31檔成分股中，僅星座能源(Constellation Energy)(CEG-US)與AES(AES-US)兩家公司上漲。

5、高風險股票反而成為「避險撤退區」

市場中最具投機性的區塊也陷入困境，高盛集團(GS-US)追蹤未盈利一籃子科技公司的指數第3季下跌11%，是該指數同期次差單季表現，成分股包括Roku(ROKU-US)與Peloton(PTON-US)。
另據盛與彭博整理數據，資產負債表最脆弱、負債較高的企業第3季僅上漲1.9%，是2022年初、Fed展開升息循環以來最小的單季漲幅。
不過有一派押注Fed不會再大幅升息。Wealth Consulting Group執行長Jimmy Lee不認為美債殖利率飆升會失控，他表示，投資人只是在拋售對利率敏感的股票，他正以較低的估值買進金融與工業類股。
但他提醒道：「標普500指數最大的風險，是AI行情意外反轉。」
paras_en: US 10-year Treasury yields rose to 5.34% on Thursday (the 1st), a peak not seen since 2002, prompting traders to debate when bond‑market selling might start to weigh more heavily on an otherwise resilient US equity market. From inside the market, the rate spike has already dealt a serious blow.

Bloomberg reports that even though the S&P 500 is less than 2% away from its all‑time high, rate‑sensitive small‑cap stocks as well as banks and utilities have suffered sharp sell‑offs. Many speculative equities—including unprofitable tech firms and companies with the weakest balance sheets—have lagged the broader market since the Fed began its first rate hike in three years.

iCapital global investment strategist Dan Suzuki said, “Most of the market has already fallen at least 5% from its highs, and some sectors are down more than 15%. A large part of that is due to higher rates and the resulting tightening of financial conditions.”

The US equity market is showing a rare historical pattern: AI‑driven rallies are supporting prices, yet at the same time the market is operating in an environment that historically triggers sharp turbulence – heightened geopolitical risk, rising rates and uncertainty around the US mid‑term elections.

Eric Diton, president and managing director of The Wealth Alliance, said, “As long as the economy and corporate earnings keep growing strongly, the market can still tolerate higher yields.” He remains cautious on equities and has added energy stocks to hedge against the impact of higher bond yields and oil prices.
He added, “The biggest risk to the market is a problem with AI infrastructure. If profit outlooks are cut, it could spark broader market pain.”
The following five angles expose the hidden pressures beneath the market’s apparent prosperity:

1. Equal‑weight S&P 500 continues to weaken – market breadth lights up red. The S&P 500 Equal‑Weighted Index, which gives each component the same weight, may be on its seventh consecutive week of decline, reviving concerns that market breadth is too narrow. In other words, the current bull run is being driven mainly by a handful of large‑cap stocks.

If the weakness persists through Friday, it would mark the third time in history the equal‑weight S&P 500 has fallen for seven straight weeks. Bloomberg data show the previous two instances occurred after the 2002 dot‑com bust and during the 2022 bear‑market sell‑off.

Not everyone sees this as a sign that the bull market is ending. Michael Purves, CEO of Tallbacken Capital Advisors, argues it reflects a strong bull market and major disruptive innovation in tech. He targets the S&P 500 at 8,500 points by year‑end, implying roughly 11% upside.

2. Small‑caps take a beating – Russell 2000 on the brink of correction. Higher rates and yields are hitting small‑cap stocks, which typically carry more debt and less diversified businesses. The Russell 2000 lagged the S&P 500 by almost 10 percentage points in Q3, its worst relative performance since 1999.
The Russell 2000 is down 8.5% from its August 14 historic high, just one step away from a correction zone.

Speculative small‑caps are more exposed than large‑cap peers; financials and industrials, which are more cyclical, make up a larger share of the Russell 2000 than of the S&P 500, while the S&P 500 is weighted toward AI‑driven tech stocks that have shone this year.
Bloomberg data also show that “zombie stocks” – companies struggling or unable to service their debt interest – account for more than one‑third of the Russell 2000 constituents.

3. Bank stocks plunge – higher borrowing costs squeeze profit outlooks. Although US consumers keep spending and companies keep borrowing, which should help banks, bank shares have fallen sharply in recent weeks, dragging the KBW Nasdaq Bank Index (BKX‑US), composed of 24 large banks, more than 12% below its mid‑August peak and into correction territory.
The KBW Nasdaq Bank Index is up 3.3% year‑to‑date, still lagging the S&P 500’s 12% gain.

Rising borrowing costs, higher Treasury yields and credit‑risk concerns are compressing banks’ near‑term profit expectations. In addition, Meta’s new generative‑AI model, Mus, sparked a sell‑off in financial stocks because the technology could erode the habit of keeping cash in low‑interest checking accounts – the so‑called “consumption inertia.”
Capital One Financial (COF‑US), Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) and Huntington Bancshares (HBAN‑US) have been the worst performers in the KBX index this year, down 20%, 14% and 12% respectively.
4. Defensive utilities also falter – high yields erode dividend appeal. Defensive utility stocks have been hit hard because rising yields make bonds more attractive than utility equities.

Since its February peak, the S&P 500 Utilities Index has fallen about 17%, edging toward bear‑market territory. Adding to the pressure are expectations of higher US natural‑gas inventories and short‑term Treasury yields that now exceed the dividend yields that usually attract investors to utilities.

10‑year Treasury yields jumped nearly 1 percentage point in Q3, a 24‑year high, while the S&P 500 Utilities Index slid 13%. Of the index’s 31 components, only Constellation Energy (CEG‑US) and AES (AES‑US) posted gains.

5. High‑risk stocks become a “flight‑to‑safety” zone. The most speculative segment of the market is also under strain; Goldman Sachs’ (GS‑US) index of unprofitable tech companies fell 11% in Q3, the worst quarterly performance for that index, which includes stocks such as Roku (ROKU‑US) and Peloton (PTON‑US).
Bloomberg and Goldman data show that the most balance‑sheet‑fragile, highly leveraged firms rose only 1.9% in Q3 – the smallest quarterly gain since early 2022 when the Fed began its rate‑hike cycle.

However, some bet the Fed will not raise rates further. Jimmy Lee, CEO of Wealth Consulting Group, does not think the surge in Treasury yields will get out of control. He says investors are merely selling rate‑sensitive stocks, and he is buying financial and industrial shares at lower valuations.
He cautions, “The biggest risk to the S&P 500 is an unexpected reversal of the AI rally.”

items.title: 把AI搬上桌面！輝達推64GB新機 免靠雲端也能跑模型
items.title_en: Bringing AI to the Desktop! NVIDIA Launches 64GB DGX Spark, Runs Models Locally Without Cloud
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)正將AI代理商機延伸至開發者桌面，周五(2日)宣布10月23日透過合作品牌推出64GB版DGX Spark，售價4,999美元起，讓開發者在自己的設備上執行AI模型與代理。新配置可連接兩台設備擴大運算規模，顯示輝達除了供應大型AI基礎設施，也持續布局本地運算市場。
根據輝達公告，新產品將由宏碁(2353-TW)、華碩(2357-TW)、戴爾(DELL-US)、技嘉(2376-TW)、惠普(HPQ-US)與微星(2377-TW)推出，保留與128GB版本相同的GB10 Grace Blackwell超級晶片、DGX OS及AI軟體平台。

AI代理走向本地運算 硬體與軟體平台同步布局

輝達表示，64GB版本可在設備上執行最多1,000億參數的模型，適用於AI代理、推論、微調與資料科學。開發者可讓程式編寫或研究代理持續運作，處理程式碼審查、文件分析及多步驟任務，無須每項工作都依賴雲端服務。
這項產品的商業意義，在於將AI硬體需求延伸至開發者與研究團隊。隨著模型與代理應用在本地部署，輝達可透過GB10晶片、網路連接及CUDA軟體工具，爭取更多工作流程使用其平台。不過，這是依產品設計觀察的市場機會，公司尚未公布新配置的訂單或出貨預估。
DGX Spark支援Ollama、vLLM及PyTorch等工具，並提供輝達AI代理工具與Nemotron開放模型。月底預計推出的NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher，則將簡化模型下載、啟動與跨設備配置，降低使用者自行設定環境的負擔。
本地運算也讓開發者能在自己的設備上處理資料，對重視隱私或需要持續執行代理的工作具有吸引力。但購買硬體是否比使用雲端更划算，仍取決於使用頻率、模型需求與維護成本。

記憶體容量牽動擴充 售價與實際效能仍是考驗

當模型、上下文長度或同時運作的代理數量增加，記憶體容量就可能成為限制。輝達表示，兩台64GB設備可透過內建ConnectX-7網路連接，合計提供128GB記憶體，支援最多2,000億參數模型。
NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant會偵測連接設備、驗證配置並設定網路，使用者擴充時無須重新建立整套軟體環境。在輝達的Qwen 3.8 27B測試中，兩台64GB設備的效能最高達單台的1.7倍，不過這是針對特定模型的測試結果，不代表執行其他AI任務時，也能達到相同的效能提升。
從記憶體產業角度看，本地AI設備若逐漸普及，可望增加高容量記憶體的應用需求。輝達既有128GB版DGX Spark採用LPDDR5X統一記憶體；新64GB配置的具體供應商與採購規模，則未在這份公告中揭露。
因此，產品推出可視為本地AI市場布局的進展，尚不足以推論特定記憶體業者將大幅受惠。4,999美元起的售價，也意味市場仍須檢驗開發者是否願意投入，以及實際效能能否支持長期使用。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) is extending its AI agent business to developers' desktops, announcing on Friday the October 23 launch of a 64GB version of the DGX Spark starting at $4,999, allowing developers to run AI models and agents on their own hardware. The new configuration can link two devices to scale compute, showing NVIDIA is not only supplying large‑scale AI infrastructure but also continuing to target the local compute market.

According to NVIDIA’s announcement, the new product will be offered by Acer (2353-TW), ASUS (2357-TW), Dell (DELL-US), Gigabyte (2376-TW), HP (HPQ-US) and MSI (2377-TW), and will retain the same GB10 Grace Blackwell super‑chip, DGX OS and AI software platform as the 128GB version.

NVIDIA says the 64GB model can run up to 100 billion‑parameter models on‑device, suitable for AI agents, inference, fine‑tuning and data science. Developers can keep code‑writing or research agents running continuously for tasks such as code review, document analysis and multi‑step workflows without relying on cloud services for every job.

The commercial significance of the product lies in extending AI hardware demand to developers and research teams. As models and agents are deployed locally, NVIDIA can leverage the GB10 chip, network connectivity and CUDA tools to capture more workflow usage of its platform. However, this is a market opportunity inferred from product design; the company has not disclosed order or shipment forecasts for the new configuration.

DGX Spark supports tools such as Ollama, vLLM and PyTorch, and includes NVIDIA AI agent tools and the open Nemotron model. NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher, expected later this month, will simplify model download, launch and cross‑device configuration, reducing the burden of setting up environments manually.

Local compute also lets developers process data on their own machines, which is attractive for privacy‑sensitive work or tasks that require agents to run continuously. Whether buying hardware is more cost‑effective than using the cloud still depends on usage frequency, model requirements and maintenance costs.

Memory capacity becomes a limiting factor as model size, context length or the number of concurrent agents grow. NVIDIA notes that two 64GB units can be linked via built‑in ConnectX‑7 networking to provide a combined 128GB of memory, supporting models up to 200 billion parameters.

NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant detects connected devices, validates configurations and sets up networking, so users can expand without rebuilding the entire software stack. In NVIDIA’s Qwen 3.8 27B benchmark, two 64GB units achieved up to 1.7× the performance of a single unit, though this result applies only to that specific model and does not guarantee similar gains for other AI tasks.

From a memory‑industry perspective, wider adoption of local AI devices could boost demand for high‑capacity memory. NVIDIA’s existing 128GB DGX Spark uses LPDDR5X unified memory; the specific suppliers and procurement scale for the new 64GB configuration were not disclosed in the announcement.

Thus, the product launch marks progress in NVIDIA’s local AI market strategy but is insufficient to conclude that any particular memory vendor will see a major benefit. The starting price of $4,999 also means the market must still test whether developers are willing to invest and whether real‑world performance justifies long‑term use.

items.title: 不只賺上市費！高盛靠客戶早期押注SpaceX 再收數億美元
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Earns More Than IPO Fees: Early Client Bets on SpaceX Yield Hundreds of Millions
paras: 高盛(GS-US)從SpaceX(SPCX-US)今年6月的上市案獲得豐厚收入，但更大的收益來源，是多年前替富裕客戶安排的早期投資。知情人士透露，隨著SpaceX以1.77兆美元估值上市，出售持股的高盛客戶獲利豐厚，也為銀行帶來數億美元績效報酬。
據《彭博》報導，高盛早在五年多前、SpaceX估值僅數百億美元時，就協助客戶投資馬斯克旗下這家公司。高盛合夥人也能與客戶共同投資，意味部分現任及前任高階主管可能同樣獲得可觀收益。高盛發言人拒絕置評。
高盛管理約4兆美元資產的資產與財富管理部門，能替客戶取得少見的未上市公司投資機會。這類投資往往風險較高，但SpaceX案例也凸顯，在企業上市前提早布局的潛在回報。由Kristin Olson領導的富裕客戶另類投資業務，也曾協助客戶參與Stripe與Canva的早期募資。
相較之下，高盛另一部門的投資銀行團隊，擔任SpaceX上市主要顧問，取得約1億美元費用。銀行還曾在紐約總部大廳擺放火箭模型，為上市案造勢。
知情人士表示，這筆未納入財務預估的績效報酬，促使高盛決定提前執行部分慈善捐贈，以提高稅務效率。今年生效的稅制變動，為企業慈善捐款扣除額設立新門檻，只有超過門檻的部分才能享有稅務減免，因而增加集中、提前捐贈的誘因。
執行長蘇德巍(David Solomon)上月已向投資人透露，公司將以「非常具稅務效率」的方式，提前完成數年的慈善捐贈。
他也提醒，這項安排加上科技投資等支出增加，將推高高盛第三季的非薪酬費用。公司預定10月13日公布第三季財報，相關收益與支出的影響屆時將受到關注。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) earned substantial revenue from SpaceX's (SPCX-US) June 2024 IPO, but its larger profit source stems from early‑stage investments arranged for wealthy clients years ago. Sources said that as SpaceX went public with a $1.77 trillion valuation, Goldman’s clients who sold their shares made huge gains, generating performance fees of several hundred million dollars for the bank.

According to Bloomberg, Goldman helped clients invest in Elon Musk’s company more than five years ago when SpaceX was valued at only a few tens of billions. Goldman partners could co‑invest alongside clients, meaning some current and former senior executives may also have realized sizable returns. A Goldman spokesperson declined to comment.

Goldman’s asset and wealth management division, which oversees about $4 trillion in assets, can secure rare private‑company investment opportunities for clients. Such investments are typically higher‑risk, but the SpaceX case highlights the potential upside of getting in before a firm goes public. The alternative‑investment team for affluent clients, led by Kristin Olson, has also helped clients participate in early fundraises for Stripe and Canva.

By contrast, Goldman’s investment‑banking team, which acted as the lead advisor on SpaceX’s IPO, earned roughly $100 million in fees. The bank even displayed a rocket model in the lobby of its New York headquarters to promote the offering.

Sources said the performance fee, which was not included in the firm’s financial forecasts, prompted Goldman to accelerate part of its charitable giving to improve tax efficiency. A tax rule change effective this year set a new threshold for corporate charitable‑donation deductions, allowing tax benefits only for amounts above the threshold, thereby incentivising larger, earlier contributions.
CEO David Solomon told investors last month that the firm would complete several years of charitable donations ahead of schedule in a "highly tax‑efficient" manner.

He also warned that, together with increased spending on technology investments, the arrangement will lift Goldman’s non‑salary expenses in the third quarter. The company plans to release its Q3 earnings on October 13, when the impact of these gains and costs will be closely scrutinised.

items.title: 輝達盤中再創高！市值衝5.7兆美元 史上首家6兆美元企業近了？
items.title_en: NVIDIA Hits New Intraday High! Market Cap Rises to $5.7 Trillion, Within $300 Billion of Becoming the First $6 Trillion Company?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價周五盤中(2日)一度上漲2.9%，首度突破今年5月以來的紀錄，市值升至約5.7兆美元，距離成為史上首家市值達6兆美元的企業，已不到3,000億美元。投資人重新湧入這家全球市值最高的上市公司，帶動股價自7月底低點反彈近25%。
截稿前，輝達盤中股價上漲2.09%，每股暫報235.68美元；市值暫報5.68兆美元。
據《彭博》報導，輝達先前因市場擔憂人工智慧(AI)前景，歷經兩個月賣壓，市值一度蒸發逾1兆美元。近期隨著AI代理應用帶動晶片需求的期待升高，加上公司擴大股票回購，股價重拾漲勢。
Meta(META-US)旗下Muse等AI代理服務，被市場視為可能推升半導體需求的新動力。輝達周一另宣布，將股票回購計畫增加1,500億美元，新增規模創公司紀錄，進一步提振投資人信心。
不過，輝達這波反彈也反映AI產業情緒快速變化。過去幾個月，市場持續質疑企業投入數千億美元建置AI基礎設施的效益，也愈來愈關注先進AI可能對人類帶來的安全風險。
為回應相關疑慮，輝達周一推出新的雙層AI安全系統，目標是防止AI代理失控。公司表示，這套系統原本可以阻止近期OpenAI模型入侵開源平台Hugging Face的事件。在投資人更加重視AI安全之際，這項措施也成為輝達近期布局的一環。
輝達今年以來股價累計上漲約27%，有望連續第四年繳出雙位數報酬。隨著市值逼近6兆美元，AI代理能否持續帶動晶片需求，以及企業龐大AI投資的前景，仍牽動市場對其成長潛力的評估。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) shares rose as much as 2.9% during Friday’s session (the 2nd), breaking the record set in May this year for the first time; its market value climbed to roughly $5.7 trillion, now less than $300 billion away from becoming the first company ever to reach a $6 trillion valuation. Investors poured back into the world’s most valuable listed firm, lifting the stock about 25% from its late‑July low.
At the time of writing, NVIDIA’s intraday price was up 2.09%, reporting a provisional $235.68 per share and a market cap of about $5.68 trillion.

According to Bloomberg, NVIDIA had previously faced market worries about the outlook for artificial intelligence (AI), enduring two months of selling pressure that erased more than $1 trillion in market value. Recently, rising expectations for chip demand driven by AI‑agent applications and an expanded share‑repurchase program have helped the stock regain its upward momentum.

Meta’s (META-US) AI‑agent services such as Muse are seen by the market as a potential new driver of semiconductor demand. On Monday, NVIDIA also announced an additional $150 billion to its share‑repurchase plan, the largest increase in the company’s history, further bolstering investor confidence.

However, this rally also reflects the rapid shifts in sentiment toward the AI industry. In recent months, the market has continued to question the value of companies spending tens of billions of dollars to build AI infrastructure and has grown increasingly concerned about the safety risks that advanced AI could pose to humanity.

In response to those concerns, NVIDIA launched a new two‑layer AI safety system on Monday aimed at preventing AI agents from going out of control. The company said the system could have blocked the recent incident in which an OpenAI model attempted to infiltrate the open‑source platform Hugging Face. As investors place greater emphasis on AI safety, the measure has become part of NVIDIA’s recent strategic rollout.

Since the start of the year, NVIDIA’s stock has risen about 27%, positioning it for a fourth consecutive year of double‑digit returns. With market value edging toward $6 trillion, whether AI agents can sustain chip demand and the outlook for massive corporate AI spending will continue to shape market assessments of the company’s growth potential.

items.title: 油輪重返荷姆茲難救通膨！布蘭特油價破百 煉油瓶頸加劇美債拋售潮
items.title_en: Oil Tankers Return to the Hormuz Strait Fails to Ease Inflation! Brent Crude Breaks $100, Refining Bottlenecks Intensify US Treasury Sell‑off
paras: 油輪重返荷姆茲海峽，原本應該有助於壓低原油、汽油與柴油價格，進而抑制通膨並降低全球借貸成本，但目前情況並非如此：供應鏈將原油轉化為燃料的環節仍遭受衝擊，持續推高能源價格，助長美債賣壓。
在美軍削弱伊朗對荷姆茲海峽控制的情況下，石油運輸量逐漸回升至接近戰前水準，但作為全球原油期貨基準的布蘭特原油周四(1日)仍大漲4.4%至每桶102.31美元。由美國汽車協會(AAA)追蹤的美國汽油平均價格仍維持在每加侖4.41美元以上。10年期美債殖利率本周則升至24年來最高水準。
華爾街日報(WSJ)報導，導致債券殖利率居高不下的因素，來自多項彼此交織的威脅，而這些因素正持續擠壓石油市場：

荷姆茲海峽的船舶通行量預估分歧很大，交易員擔心局勢再度升溫，隨時可能讓供應量大幅下降。
葉門胡塞武裝(Houthi)持續威脅阿拉伯半島周邊同樣運輸石油的航線。
距離中東數千英里之外，烏克蘭持續發動空襲，鎖定俄羅斯煉油廠，而俄羅斯煉油廠過去一直是供應柴油給許多工業經濟體的重要來源。


這些因素推高了原油運輸與燃料加工成本，進而提高汽車、卡車、商用飛機及農業設備等各類交通與生產工具的營運成本。

荷姆茲運輸恢復 成品油供應仍吃緊

這項瓶頸正讓美國通膨受到後續衝擊，影響可能持續到11月期中選舉之後，並迫使聯準會(Fed)考慮未來數月進一步升息。與此同時，債券市場早就難以消化人工智慧(AI)相關債務大量湧現、龐大的財政赤字，以及足以讓通膨持續超標的強勁經濟。
10年期美債殖利率周四雖然稍稍回落至5.233%，但在周三為止的一季創下1994年以來最大單季升幅，並推動美國房貸利率突破7%。
瑞銀投資銀行(UBS Investment Bank)全球經濟與策略主管Arend Kapteyn說：「目前市場對美國與伊朗是否朝某種正式協議取得進展，以及局勢是否可能進一步中斷供應，仍高度敏感。從央行的角度來看，不能只關注原油，還要關注(煉製)成品油，而成品油市場非常吃緊。」

庫存緩衝大減

目前美國海軍逐漸削弱伊朗攻擊油輪或附近能源設施的能力，在戰爭開打八個月後，波斯灣產油國與航運公司也愈來愈擅長抵禦或躲避攻擊。摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)分析師預估，中東原油出口量近期如今僅比戰前水準低7%。
但考量到許多油輪關閉追蹤系統，或在船與船之間轉移貨物以降低遭到攻擊的風險，其他分析師對航運恢復程度仍抱持審慎態度。
伊朗在葉門的代理人胡塞武裝再次攻擊區域航線，也促使交易員在持有部位納入更高的風險溢價，進而支撐能源價格。
伊朗戰爭爆發至今，市場一直靠從中國、歐洲到美國的庫存提供緩衝，但如今庫存已大幅下降，需要重新補充，而且幾乎沒有犯錯的空間。這種不確定性讓交易員緊盯美國與中國可能限制燃料出口的消息。

中東成品油出口比戰前低40%

儘管原油期貨價格已從近期高點回落，但實體原油貨物的價格仍維持高檔，顯示煉油商爭相鎖定短期供應。用來追蹤即期交割的基準價格、北海現貨原油價格是周四報每桶127.42美元。
CIBC Private Wealth資深能源交易員Rebecca Babin說：「無論數據顯示有多少原油正經過荷姆茲海峽，市場的需求顯然仍存在。」
摩根大通(JP Morgan)預估，中東汽油、柴油與航空燃油等成品油出口量，目前仍比戰前水準低約40%。

原油進入市場成本大增

還要考慮一點：油輪運輸量雖然回升，但原油進入市場的成本也大幅飆升。從波斯灣向西航行的油輪，有時必須繞行非洲南端，以避開胡塞武裝的攻擊威脅。此外，許多航運公司會將石油從波斯灣運往荷姆茲海峽外圍，再在當地轉運給前往其他目的地的船隻。
這些因素占用了全球大量超大型油輪運力，並推高運費。根據Argus數據，從中東運送原油至中國的超大型油輪，近期一趟約21天的航程，成本相當於每桶35美元，而戰爭爆發前一天的成本還不到每桶7美元。

中東煉油產能下降 柴油與原油價差創紀錄

當原油抵達煉油廠後，成本壓力又進一步擴大。由於中東煉油產能下降，加上烏克蘭攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，促使莫斯科限制柴油出口，交易員願意向其他仍有能力大量生產燃料的企業支付溢價。
在紐約，柴油期貨近期價格約為原油價格的兩倍，柴油與原油之間的價差遠超過過去任何紀錄，推升加油站的批發成本。
許多能源業高層預料這種情況將持續。達拉斯聯準銀行本周公布的調查顯示，48%的受訪者認為，柴油價格與原油成本之間的價差至少需要一年才會恢復至2025年水準，約36%的受訪者對汽油價差也持相同看法。

殖利率仍可能走高

美國企業在年初或戰爭爆發後初期鎖定的部分避險成本，如今即將到期，讓農民、居家修繕商店及卡車業者等企業正面臨艱難抉擇。
U.S. Bank商品團隊主管Charlie Macnamara指出，目前較高的價格「將開始滲透到這些企業的避險計畫中，最終也會傳導至終端消費者」。
儘管能源價格仍處於令人難以承受的高檔，分析師認為，能源價格目前還沒有高到足以迫使經濟大幅放緩的程度，尤其美國經濟仍受到人工智慧(AI)熱潮與創歷史新高的股市支撐。
Principal Asset Management首席全球策略師Seema Shah說：「如果經濟韌性與投資需求持續，殖利率可能仍有進一步走高的空間。」
paras_en: Oil tankers have returned to the Hormuz Strait, which should have helped lower crude, gasoline and diesel prices and thus curb inflation and reduce global borrowing costs, but that is not the case: the supply‑chain link that turns crude into fuel is still under pressure, keeping energy prices high and feeding the sell‑off in US Treasuries.

With US forces weakening Iran’s control of the Hormuz Strait, oil shipments are gradually climbing back toward pre‑war levels, yet Brent crude – the global benchmark – jumped 4.4% on Thursday the 1st to $102.31 a barrel. The average US gasoline price tracked by the American Automobile Association (AAA) remains above $4.41 per gallon, and 10‑year US Treasury yields this week rose to their highest level in 24 years.
The Wall Street Journal reported that the forces keeping bond yields elevated stem from a web of inter‑linked threats that are also squeezing the oil market.

Estimates of ship traffic through the Hormuz Strait vary widely, and traders fear a resurgence of tension could sharply cut supplies. Houthi rebels in Yemen continue to threaten oil‑carrying routes around the Arabian Peninsula. Thousands of miles away, Ukraine keeps launching air strikes on Russian refineries, which have long been a key diesel source for many industrial economies.

The bottleneck is feeding back into US inflation and could affect the market through the November mid‑term elections, forcing the Federal Reserve to consider further rate hikes in the coming months. At the same time, the bond market has long struggled to absorb a flood of AI‑related debt, massive fiscal deficits and a robust economy that keeps inflation above target.
Although 10‑year Treasury yields slipped slightly to 5.233% on Thursday, they had set the biggest quarterly gain since 1994 by Wednesday and pushed US mortgage rates past 7%.

Arend Kapteyn, global economics and strategy head at UBS Investment Bank, said: “The market remains highly sensitive to any progress toward a formal agreement between the US and Iran or to any further supply disruptions. From a central‑bank perspective you can’t just watch crude; you have to watch refined products, and the refined‑product market is extremely tight.”

Inventory buffers have shrunk dramatically. The US Navy is gradually reducing Iran’s ability to attack tankers or nearby energy facilities, and eight months into the war, Persian Gulf producers and shipping firms have become more adept at evading or defending against attacks. Morgan Stanley analysts estimate that Middle‑East crude exports are now only about 7% below pre‑war levels.
However, because many tankers have disabled tracking systems or are transshipping cargo between vessels to lower attack risk, other analysts remain cautious about how fully shipping has recovered.
Iran’s Houthi proxies in Yemen have again struck regional routes, prompting traders to price a higher risk premium into their positions and thereby supporting energy prices.

Since the war began, markets have relied on inventories from China, Europe and the US for buffering, but those stocks have now fallen sharply, need replenishment and leave almost no margin for error. This uncertainty has traders watching closely for any news that the US or China might restrict fuel exports.

Middle‑East refined‑product exports are about 40% lower than before the war. Although crude futures have retreated from recent peaks, spot physical crude prices remain high, showing refiners scrambling for short‑term supply. The benchmark spot price for North Sea crude was $127.42 a barrel on Thursday.
Rebecca Babin, a senior energy trader at CIBC Private Wealth, said: “No matter how much crude the data show moving through the Hormuz Strait, demand in the market is clearly still there.”
JP Morgan estimates that Middle‑East exports of gasoline, diesel and jet fuel are still roughly 40% below pre‑war levels.

The cost of getting crude into the market has surged. Even though tanker volumes are rising, ships sailing west from the Persian Gulf sometimes have to detour around the southern tip of Africa to avoid Houthi attacks. Many carriers also move oil from the Gulf to the outer Hormuz area before transshipping to vessels bound for other destinations.

These practices tie up a large share of the world’s ultra‑large crude tanker capacity and lift freight rates. Argus data show that a recent 21‑day voyage from the Middle East to China now costs about $35 per barrel, versus less than $7 per barrel the day before the war started.

Middle‑East refining capacity has fallen, widening the diesel‑to‑crude spread to record levels. With reduced refining in the region and Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries prompting Moscow to curb diesel exports, traders are willing to pay premiums to firms that can still produce fuel in large volumes.
In New York, diesel futures are currently trading at roughly twice the price of crude, a spread that far exceeds any historical record and pushes up wholesale costs for gas stations.

Many energy executives expect this situation to persist. A Dallas Fed survey this week found that 48% of respondents think the diesel‑crude spread will not return to 2025 levels for at least a year, and about 36% hold the same view for the gasoline spread.

Yield pressures may keep rising. Hedging costs that US companies locked in early in the year or shortly after the war began are now expiring, leaving farmers, home‑improvement retailers and trucking firms facing tough choices.
Charlie Macnamara, head of the commodities team at U.S. Bank, said higher prices “will start to seep into these companies’ hedging programs and ultimately be passed on to end consumers.”

Even though energy prices remain painfully high, analysts say they are not yet high enough to force a sharp economic slowdown, especially as the US economy is still buoyed by the AI boom and record‑high equity markets.
Seema Shah, chief global strategist at Principal Asset Management, warned: “If economic resilience and investment demand persist, yields could still have room to move higher.”

items.title: 連兩年下滑後有轉機？特斯拉Q3交車勝預期 分析師看好全年銷量
items.title_en: Is There a Turnaround After Two Years of Decline? Tesla Q3 Deliveries Beat Expectations, Analysts Optimistic About Full-Year Sales
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)周五(2日)公布，第三季全球交車量達48萬6,532輛，優於華爾街預期，顯示核心汽車業務在連續兩年銷量下滑後，開始出現回穩跡象。歐洲需求復甦，抵銷美國購車稅務優惠取消及中國競爭加劇的部分壓力，帶動股價早盤上漲。
綜合外媒報導，特斯拉交車量高於《彭博》彙整的46萬3,761輛平均預估，也超過Visible Alpha調查的45萬6,896輛。截至紐約時間上午9時34分，股價上漲4%；不過，截至前一交易日，今年累計仍下跌逾21%。
截稿前，特斯拉(TSLA-US)周五盤中股價上漲5.44%，每股暫報373.37美元。

交車優於預期 全年有望終結連兩年下滑

第三季交車量仍低於去年同期的49萬7,099輛，年減約2.1%。去年同期因美國消費者趕在聯邦購車優惠取消前購車，創下季度交車紀錄，墊高比較基期。
今年第三季Model 3與Model Y合計交付47萬8,237輛，其餘車款僅8,295輛，顯示兩款主力車仍占絕大多數銷量。同期產量為46萬4,391輛，低於市場預估的48萬6,761輛。
特斯拉第四季至少需交付31萬1,448輛，才能避免全年交車量連續第三年下滑。分析師已將2026年全年預估由6月的165萬輛上修至182萬輛，反映需求前景改善。
歐洲是主要支撐。特斯拉去年因馬斯克政治立場引發反彈而銷售受挫，今年前八個月歐盟新車掛牌量則成長66%，8月成長約53%。Model Y更成為法國單月最暢銷車款，首次有特斯拉車型登上該榜首。
上海廠7、8月出口量也接近翻倍，協助抵銷中國市場競爭壓力。分析師預期，已獲歐洲八國批准的全自動輔助駕駛(FSD)軟體，隨部署推進可望進一步支持銷售。

AI布局仍牽動估值 汽車業務提供營收支撐

儘管馬斯克持續將投資人焦點轉向AI、自動駕駛與Optimus人形機器人，汽車仍是特斯拉最大的營收來源。公司約1.4兆美元估值高度仰賴長期願景，季度交車仍是檢視核心業務的重要指標。
特斯拉在德州與佛州的自駕計程車服務，已不再配置車內安全監督員，上月也將專用車款Cybercab加入奧斯汀營運。不過，服務規模仍小於Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Waymo。
公司今年計劃支出逾250億美元，擴建工廠並發展自駕計程車業務，本周文件另揭露，已取得300億美元新貸款與信用額度。
能源業務方面，第三季儲能部署量達13.7GWh，高於去年同期的12.5GWh及第二季的13.5GWh。汽車與儲能表現改善，但龐大投資能否轉化為持續成長，仍是後續觀察重點。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) announced on Friday the 2nd that its global deliveries for the third quarter reached 486,532 vehicles, surpassing Wall Street forecasts and indicating that the core automotive business is showing signs of stabilizing after two consecutive years of sales declines. A recovery in European demand offset some pressure from the removal of U.S. purchase tax incentives and heightened competition in China, lifting the stock in early trading.

According to foreign media reports, Tesla's deliveries exceeded Bloomberg's consensus estimate of 463,761 vehicles and also beat Visible Alpha's forecast of 456,896 units. By 9:34 a.m. New York time, the share price was up 4%, though it remains down more than 21% for the year as of the previous trading day.
Just before the deadline, Tesla (TSLA-US) saw its intraday price rise 5.44% on Friday, briefly trading at $373.37 per share.

Deliveries beat expectations, raising hopes that the full year could finally end the two‑year decline. Third‑quarter deliveries were still below last year’s 497,099, a year‑over‑year drop of about 2.1%. Last year’s figure was boosted by U.S. consumers rushing to buy before the federal purchase incentive expired, setting a record quarterly delivery that raised the comparison base.

In the third quarter, Model 3 and Model Y together accounted for 478,237 deliveries, with the remaining models totaling only 8,295 units, showing that the two flagship models still dominate sales. Production for the period was 464,391, below the market estimate of 486,761.

Tesla will need to deliver at least 311,448 vehicles in the fourth quarter to avoid a third consecutive year of overall delivery declines. Analysts have raised their 2026 full‑year estimate from 1.65 million units in June to 1.82 million, reflecting an improving demand outlook.

Europe is the main support. After a sales dip last year due to backlash over Elon Musk’s political stance, new‑car registrations in the EU grew 66% in the first eight months of this year, with August alone up about 53%. The Model Y even became France’s best‑selling car for a month, the first time a Tesla model has topped the chart there.

Exports from the Shanghai plant in July and August nearly doubled, helping to offset competitive pressure in the Chinese market. Analysts expect that the fully autonomous driving (FSD) software, already approved in eight European countries, will further boost sales as deployment progresses.

AI initiatives still drive valuation, but the automotive business provides revenue support. Although Musk continues to shift investor focus toward AI, autonomous driving and the Optimus humanoid robot, cars remain Tesla’s biggest revenue source. The company’s roughly $1.4 trillion valuation heavily relies on its long‑term vision, and quarterly deliveries remain a key gauge of core business health.

Tesla’s autonomous‑taxi services in Texas and Florida no longer staff safety monitors inside the vehicles, and last month added the dedicated Cybercab model to its Austin fleet. However, the service scale remains smaller than Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Waymo.

The company plans to spend over $25 billion this year expanding factories and developing autonomous‑taxi operations, and documents released this week revealed it has secured a new $30 billion loan and credit facility.

In its energy segment, third‑quarter energy storage deployments reached 13.7 GWh, higher than 12.5 GWh in the same quarter last year and 13.5 GWh in the second quarter. While automotive and storage performance have improved, whether the massive investments can translate into sustained growth remains a key focus for the future.

paras_en: October 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – September US employment data came in below expectations, prompting the market to lower expectations for another near‑term Fed rate hike. Treasury yields fell and US equities opened higher on Friday, with the Nasdaq posting another all‑time high.

As of 10:14 a.m. Eastern Time, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 0.60%, the S&P 500 rose 1.02%, and the Nasdaq climbed 1.66%. Technology and semiconductor stocks led the gains, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 3.1%; NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) jumped 2.5% and hit an intraday record high, Tesla (TSLA‑US) rose 4.1%, and Oracle (ORCL‑US) gained 3%.

The US Labor Department reported that non‑farm payrolls added only 29,000 jobs in September, well below the market forecast of 90,000, and the figures for the prior two months were also sharply revised downward. After the release, the probability of a Fed rate hike in October fell from 26% to 20%, and the two‑year Treasury yield slipped for the second consecutive day.

Oil prices fell in tandem, with Brent crude slipping below $100 a barrel, and the VIX fear gauge dropped to a one‑week low. On the equity side, Nike (NKE‑US) saw its shares plunge 5.6% after warning of weak demand in China and a significant decline in full‑year revenue.

items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: Cold Nonfarm Payrolls Boosted Markets, Nasdaq Posts Third Consecutive Weekly Gain
paras: 美國 9 月非農就業報告顯著降溫，市場對聯準會可能升息的預期降溫，激勵美股三大指數週五 (2 日) 全面收紅。科技股為衝鋒主力，那指盤中一度飆上新高，終場收漲 1.19% 至 27,190.86 點，距離 9 月 22 日創下的歷史高點 (27,244.28 點) 僅差不到 0.2%。
總經數據方面，美國勞工部公布 9 月非農就業僅新增 2.9 萬人，遠低於市場預期的 8.4 萬人，前兩個月的就業數據亦遭到下修；失業率則受勞動參與率提升影響，由 4.1% 略升至 4.2%，平均時薪增幅則同步放緩。
這份弱於預期的就業數據，促使投資人重新評估 Fed 的貨幣政策走向。芝商所 (CME) FedWatch 工具顯示，市場預期 Fed 在 10 月會議降息或維持利率不變的押注顯著升溫，政策緊縮壓力大為減輕。
股市表現方面，AI 巨頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 盤中再創歷史新高，超微 (AMD-US) 與資安族群同步強勢走揚，推升那斯達克 100 指數刷新紀錄。加密貨幣概念股早盤受比特幣重返 86,000 美元關卡激勵躍升，唯隨後走勢分化。
此外，七大工業國集團 (G7) 釋出可能動用緊急戰略準備的訊號後，西德州原油 (WTI) 期貨重挫 1.5% 至每桶 91.48 美元，油價顯著回落進一步撫平市場恐慌情緒。
不過，美債市場走勢出現波動。指標性的美國 10 年期公債殖利率在報告公布初時一度急挫，但隨後逆勢轉升約 4 個基點至 5.28%，壓抑了美股尾盤的漲幅。
分析指出，債市除了反映物價黏性與政府擴大財政支出外，科技巨頭為擴建 AI 基礎設施而大量發債，亦對市場流動性帶來壓力。
美股週五 (2 日) 主要指數表現：

道瓊工業指數上漲 250.40 點，或 0.49%，報 51,176.96 點。
那斯達克指數上漲 319.27 點，或 1.19%，報 27,190.86 點。
S&P 500 指數上漲 56.27 點，或 0.73%，報 7,722.72 點。
費城半導體指數上漲 307.68 點，或 2.40%，報 13,136.68 點。
NYSE FANG+ 指數上漲 106.87 點，或 0.56%，報 19,211.64 點。


週線表現部分，儘管道瓊與標普本週分別累跌 1.26% 與 0.27%，但那斯達克指數展現韌性，本週逆勢上揚 0.45%，締造連續第 3 週收升紀錄。
焦點個股
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭集體攀揚。Meta (META-US) 上漲 0.30%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.02%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 1.56%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.92%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 1.33%。
半導體主要個股普遍走高。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 2.95%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 3.35%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 1.34%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 2.03%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.53%。
記憶體與儲存族群多數下挫。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 2.05%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 重挫 10.22%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 3.79%；希捷 (STX-US) 重挫 10.21%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 0.84%。
台股 ADR 全紅。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 2.96%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 大漲 6.08%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 4.20%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 1.34%。
企業新聞
輝達 (NVDA-US) 收高 1.34%，收在 233.95 美元，逼近歷史收盤高點。輝達先前於 5 月 14 日創下 235.74 美元的收盤紀錄。公司近日將股票回購計畫額度增加 1,500 億美元，創史上最大規模。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 勁揚 4.65% 至每股 370.59 美元。這家電動車大廠第三季交車 486,532 輛，較第二季增加 1%，較去年同期減少 2%，但仍大幅優於華爾街預期。
Rivian (RIVN-US) 第三季交車 19,248 輛，高於市場預估的 18,001 輛，股價仍收黑 3.1% 至每股 14.30 美元。
安森美半導體 (ON-US) 飛升 6.01%。Synaptics (SYNA-US) 狂飆超 14%。安森美半導體同意以 57 億美元現金收購 Synaptics ，取代先前價值 70 億美元的股票交易方案。
Nike (NKE-US) 週五跌幅超 3.5%。公司第一季營收未達華爾街預期，並提出疲弱的全年財測，顯示營運轉型仍面臨挑戰。
慧與科技 (HPE-US) 噴高 7.36%，名列標普指數漲幅最大的成分股之一。慧與表示，AI 需求可望帶動網路業務營收穩健成長。
《日經》報導，東芝計劃投資 3.8 億美元擴建菲律賓廠區，將資料中心用硬碟 (HDD) 產能提高至目前的 2 倍。消息衝擊同業股價，希捷科技 (STX-US) 下殺 10.21%，威騰電子 (WDC-US) 也狂瀉 10%。
莫德納 (MRNA-US) 上漲約 0.6%。那斯達克交易所宣布，公司將於 10 月 9 日開盤前取代華納兄弟探索 (WBD-US)，納入那斯達克 100 指數。華納兄弟探索預計下週完成與 Paramount Skydance 的合併。
華爾街分析
Nuveen 投資長 Saira Malik 認為，非農就業報告可望在財報季啟動前支撐市場，並預期接下來的企業獲利表現將相當強勁。
不過，eToro 分析師 Bret Kenwell 提醒，疲弱就業數據可能再次帶動「壞消息就是好消息」的交易邏輯，但若勞動市場明顯惡化，將為經濟帶來另一項挑戰。他指出，10 年期美債殖利率的 5% 關卡值得關注，若成為新的低檔支撐，股市能否持續承受高利率將受到考驗。
Edward Jones 策略師 Angelo Kourkafas 則表示，最新數據顯示勞動市場正在降溫，但基本面仍健康。儘管高利率與地緣政治不確定性可能壓抑估值、加劇波動，持續擴張的經濟與穩健的企業獲利成長，仍可望支撐美股今年剩餘時間的表現。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: U.S. September nonfarm payrolls cooled sharply, easing market expectations of further Fed rate hikes and prompting all three major U.S. equity indexes to close higher on Friday (the 2nd). Tech stocks led the rally, with the Nasdaq soaring to a new intraday high before finishing up 1.19% at 27,190.86 points, just under 0.2% shy of the September 22 record peak of 27,244.28 points.

On the macro side, the Labor Department reported that September added only 29,000 jobs, far below the 84,000 forecast, and the figures for the prior two months were also revised down. The unemployment rate ticked up slightly from 4.1% to 4.2% as labor‑force participation rose, while average hourly earnings growth slowed.

The weaker‑than‑expected payrolls led investors to reassess the Fed’s policy path. CME’s FedWatch tool shows a sharp rise in bets that the Fed will either cut rates or hold them steady at the October meeting, easing tightening pressure considerably.

In equities, AI heavyweight Nvidia (NVDA-US) hit another all‑time high during the session, while AMD and cybersecurity stocks surged, pushing the Nasdaq‑100 to a fresh record. Crypto‑related stocks jumped early after Bitcoin reclaimed the $86,000 level, but later showed mixed performance.

In addition, after the G7 signaled it might tap emergency strategic reserves, West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures fell 1.5% to $91.48 a barrel, pulling oil prices down and calming market panic.

U.S. Treasury markets were volatile. The benchmark 10‑year yield plunged sharply right after the report’s release, then rebounded about four basis points to 5.28%, tempering the equity rally in the closing minutes.

Analysts note that the bond market reflects not only sticky inflation and expanded fiscal spending but also heavy issuance by tech giants financing AI infrastructure, which pressures market liquidity.
U.S. equity performance on Friday (the 2nd):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 250.40 points, or 0.49%, to 51,176.96. The Nasdaq Composite gained 319.27 points, or 1.19%, to 27,190.86. The S&P 500 climbed 56.27 points, or 0.73%, to 7,722.72. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 307.68 points, or 2.40%, to 13,136.68. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 106.87 points, or 0.56%, to 19,211.64.  On the weekly chart, although the Dow and S&P fell 1.26% and 0.27% respectively this week, the Nasdaq showed resilience, gaining 0.45% and marking its third straight week of advances.
Focus stocks

The five big tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index all moved higher: Meta (META‑US) up 0.30%, Apple (AAPL‑US) up 1.02%, Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) up 1.56%, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) up 0.92% and Amazon (AMZN‑US) up 1.33%.
Semiconductor leaders also rose: AMD (AMD‑US) up 2.95%, Broadcom (AVGO‑US) up 3.35%, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) up 1.34%, Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) up 2.03% and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) up 1.53%.

Memory and storage stocks mostly fell: Micron (MU‑US) down 2.05%, Western Digital (WDC‑US) plunged 10.22%, SanDisk (SNDK‑US) down 3.79%, Seagate (STX‑US) down 10.21%, while SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) rose 0.84%.
All Taiwan‑related ADRs were up: TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) up 2.96%, ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) surged 6.08%, UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 4.20% and Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) up 1.34%.
Company news
Nvidia (NVDA‑US) closed up 1.34% at $233.95, near its all‑time closing high of $235.74 set on May 14. The company recently expanded its share‑repurchase program by $150 billion, the largest ever.
Tesla (TSLA‑US) jumped 4.65% to $370.59. The automaker delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3, a 1% increase from Q2 but a 2% decline year‑over‑year, still far ahead of Wall Street forecasts.
Rivian (RIVN‑US) delivered 19,248 vehicles in Q3, beating the consensus estimate of 18,001, yet the stock closed down 3.1% at $14.30.

ON Semiconductor (ON‑US) surged 6.01% and Synaptics (SYNA‑US) rocketed more than 14% after ON agreed to acquire Synaptics for $5.7 billion in cash, replacing an earlier $7 billion stock‑swap proposal.

Nike (NKE‑US) fell more than 3.5% on Friday after first‑quarter revenue missed Wall Street expectations and the company issued a weak full‑year outlook, signaling ongoing challenges in its transformation plan.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) jumped 7.36%, making it one of the biggest gainers in the S&P 500. The firm said rising AI demand should drive solid growth in its networking revenue.

According to the Nikkei, Toshiba plans to invest $380 million to expand its Philippine plant, doubling HDD capacity for data‑center use. The news sent peers tumbling, with Seagate (STX‑US) down 10.21% and Western Digital (WDC‑US) plunging 10%.

Moderna (MRNA‑US) rose about 0.6% after Nasdaq announced that the company will replace Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD‑US) in the Nasdaq‑100 effective before the opening on October 9. Warner Bros. Discovery is expected to complete its merger with Paramount Skydance next week.
Wall Street commentary
Nuveen Chief Investment Officer Saira Malik said the payroll report should help support markets ahead of earnings season and expects corporate earnings to remain robust.

However, eToro analyst Bret Kenwell warned that weak jobs data could revive the “bad news is good news” trade, but a clearly deteriorating labor market would pose a new economic challenge. He highlighted the 5% level on the 10‑year Treasury as a key support to watch; if it holds, the equity market’s ability to endure high rates will be tested.

Edward Jones strategist Angelo Kourkafas noted that the latest data show the labor market cooling while fundamentals stay healthy. Although high rates and geopolitical uncertainty may suppress valuations and increase volatility, a still‑expanding economy and solid corporate profit growth should underpin U.S. equities for the rest of the year.

items.title_en: Dubai Airlines Exposes Major Security Breach! Omani Co‑pilot Banned from Flying Still Hired
paras: 《華爾街日報》報導，該名阿曼籍副機長曾因涉嫌極端化，遭阿曼政府禁止飛行，隨後卻仍獲杜拜航空聘用，並在空中刺傷機長企圖墜機。
杜拜航空 (FlyDubai) 1073 號班機機艙驚魂案有重大進展。據消息人士透露，涉嫌在空中刺傷機長並企圖蓄意墜機的阿曼籍副機長，先前就因涉嫌受到極端思想影響，遭阿曼政府禁止執飛。
然而，杜拜航空之後仍聘用該名機師，甚至安排他執飛阿拉伯聯合大公國與以色列之間的敏感航線，引發外界對跨國航空安全審查機制的質疑。
3 萬呎高空驚魂：乘客與備勤機師聯手化解危機
這起空中攻擊事件發生於本週三上午，班機原定從杜拜飛往特拉維夫。涉案副機長在飛行途中突然持刀刺傷機長，並操控飛機急速俯衝，客機一度因承受過大負荷，接近解體邊緣。
身受重傷的機長在危急之際奮力打開駕駛艙門，乘客與空服員隨即上前，合力制伏攻擊者。同機搭乘的 2 名備勤機師則接手駕駛，成功穩住飛機，並緊急降落沙烏地阿拉伯，化解可能造成重大傷亡的危機。
目前，受傷機長與涉案副機長均已轉送阿聯，相關調查持續進行。杜拜航空也已全面暫停往返杜拜與特拉維夫的航班。
尼坦雅胡定調為「恐怖攻擊」
以色列總理尼坦雅胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 週五明確將事件定調為恐怖攻擊，指稱涉案副機師受到伊斯蘭極端思想影響，企圖讓飛機墜毀，與全機人員同歸於盡。以色列安全單位正調查他是否與特定組織有關，以及是否有共犯，並爭取對其進行訊問。
阿聯當局目前主導調查，但對於涉案副機長在阿曼的過往紀錄，阿聯官方發言人以「避免干預調查或預判結果」為由拒絕評論。阿曼政府與杜拜航空也未回應媒體詢問。
目前尚無法確認，阿曼先前是否曾向其他國家或航空公司通報該名機師涉及的安全疑慮。
安檢與機師審查遭質疑 跨國協調成焦點
航空安全分析師指出，這起事件反映航空安全防線出現嚴重漏洞。雖然涉案刀械如何通過機場安檢仍待釐清，但具有極端思想及潛在攻擊風險的人員，理應在進入機場前，就透過安全審查加以辨識與攔阻。
事件也引發外界檢視杜拜飛往以色列航班的安檢標準。以色列官員透露，以方長期要求杜拜機場強化飛往特拉維夫航班的安全措施。
以色列國家審計長辦公室早在 2024 年 5 月的機密報告中就指出，交通部過度將資源集中於本國航空公司，對外籍航空公司飛往以色列航班的安檢投入明顯不足。此次事件也讓跨國航空安全資訊共享與機師背景審查機制，再度受到關注。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that the Omani co‑pilot, who had been barred from flying by the Omani government over alleged extremist ties, was later hired by Dubai Airlines and stabbed the captain in flight in an attempt to crash the plane.

FlyDubai flight 1073’s cabin incident has seen major developments. Sources say the Omani co‑pilot accused of stabbing the captain and attempting a deliberate crash had previously been prohibited from flying by the Omani authorities for suspected extremist influence.

Nevertheless, Dubai Airlines later employed the pilot and even assigned him to a sensitive route between the United Arab Emirates and Israel, prompting questions about cross‑border airline safety vetting mechanisms.
30,000‑foot terror in the sky: passengers and standby pilots work together to defuse the crisis

The airborne attack occurred on Wednesday morning; the flight was scheduled to depart Dubai for Tel Aviv. The co‑pilot suddenly drew a knife, wounded the captain, and forced the aircraft into a steep dive, subjecting the plane to extreme loads that brought it close to structural failure.

The severely injured captain managed to open the cockpit door in the emergency, and passengers and cabin crew rushed in to subdue the attacker. Two standby pilots on board took over the controls, steadied the aircraft and made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, averting a potentially catastrophic loss of life.
Both the injured captain and the co‑pilot have been transferred to the UAE for further investigation, and Dubai Airlines has suspended all flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv.
Netanyahu labels the incident a "terrorist attack"

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Friday unequivocally described the event as a terrorist attack, saying the co‑pilot was influenced by Islamic extremism and intended to bring down the plane with everyone on board. Israeli security agencies are probing possible links to extremist groups and any accomplices, and are seeking to interrogate the suspect.

The UAE authorities are leading the investigation, but an Emirati spokesperson declined to comment on the co‑pilot’s prior record in Oman, citing a need to avoid interfering with the probe or pre‑judging its outcome. Neither the Omani government nor Dubai Airlines responded to media inquiries.
It remains unclear whether Oman ever notified other countries or airlines about the pilot’s security concerns.
Security screening and pilot vetting come under fire; cross‑border coordination becomes the focus

Aviation safety analysts say the case highlights a serious breach in the aviation security chain. While it is still unknown how the knife passed through airport screening, individuals with extremist views and potential for attack should be identified and stopped during pre‑flight security checks.

The incident has also prompted scrutiny of security standards for Dubai‑to‑Israel flights. Israeli officials say Israel has long urged Dubai Airport to tighten security measures on flights bound for Tel Aviv.

A confidential report from Israel’s State Comptroller’s Office in May 2024 warned that the Ministry of Transport had overly concentrated resources on domestic carriers, leaving security checks for foreign airlines operating flights to Israel markedly under‑funded. This episode has revived attention on international information sharing and pilot background‑check mechanisms.

items.title: AI獨撐美股大盤！美債殖利率飆高股市表面淡定 5大面向暴露內部壓力
items.title_en: AI Propels US Stock Market While Treasury Yields Surge; Stock Market Appears Calm but Five Areas Reveal Internal Pressure
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率周四(1日)一度升至5.34%，創2002年以來新高後，股票交易員正熱烈討論，債市拋售何時會開始對韌性十足的美股造成更大壓力。但從市場內部來看，利率飆升其實已經造成嚴重衝擊。
彭博報導，儘管標普500指數距離歷史高點不到2%，但從對利率敏感的小型股，到銀行與公用事業類股，都遭遇猛烈拋售。市場中許多投機性的股票，包括尚未獲利的科技公司、以及資產負債表最脆弱的企業，自聯準會(Fed)啟動三年來首度升息之後，表現也落後大盤。
iCapital全球投資策略師Dan Suzuki說：「市場大多數部分至少已較高點下跌5%，更不用說有些市場區塊的跌幅已超過15%。其中很大一部分原因，就是利率走高，以及隨之而來的金融情勢收緊。」
美股市場出現歷史上少見的特殊現象：人工智慧(AI)行情支撐股市表現，但與此同時，市場正處於過去會導致市場劇烈震盪的環境，包括地緣政治風險升高、利率走高，以及美國期中選舉的不確定性。
The Wealth Alliance總裁兼執行董事Eric Diton說：「只要經濟與企業獲利成長維持強勁，股市目前還能承受較高殖利率。」他對股票抱持審慎態度，並買進能源股，以規避債券殖利率與原油價格走高的衝擊。
他表示：「但股市最大的風險，是AI基礎建設出現問題。如果獲利展望遭下修，就會引發更廣泛的股市痛苦。」
以下五個面向揭露股市表面繁榮下隱藏的壓力：

1、等權重標普500持續走弱 市場廣度亮紅燈

標普500等權重指數(S&P 500 Equal Weighted Index)每檔成分股權重相同，目前可能出現連續第七周下跌，重新引發市場對股市廣度過於狹窄的擔憂。換句話說，目前這波多頭行情主要由少數大型股推動。
如果這波弱勢持續至周五，將是等權重標普500指數史上第三次連續7周下跌。根據彭博整理的數據，前兩次分別發生在2002年網路泡沫破裂後，以及2022年熊市拋售期間。
但並非所有人都認為這代表股市多頭行情即將結束，Tallbacken Capital Advisors執行長Michael Purves認為這反映了多頭市場的強勁，以及科技產業的重大顛覆式創新。他對標普500指數年底目標價為8500點，代表還有近11%的上漲空間。

2、小型股遭重擊 羅素2000瀕臨修正

利率與殖利率走高正在衝擊小型企業股，這些公司通常負債較高，業務線也沒那麼多元化。以羅素2000指數(Russell 2000)為例，該指數在剛結束的第3季落後標普500指數將近10個百分點，是1999年以來表現次差。
羅素2000指數目前較8月14日歷史高點下跌8.5%，只差一步就落入修正區。
羅素2000指數的投機性高於大型股同業，金融與工業等景氣敏感型產業，在該指數中的占比較標普500高，而標普500指數則更偏重今年受AI熱潮推動、表現亮眼的科技股。
此外，彭博數據顯示，所謂「殭屍股」——也就是難以、甚至無法支付債務利息的企業——在羅素2000中的占比超過三分之一。

3、銀行股重挫 高借貸成本壓縮獲利展望

儘管美國消費者仍持續支出、企業也持續借款，都有利於銀行業務，但銀行股這幾周以來仍大幅走跌，導致由24家大型銀行組成的KBW那斯達克銀行指數(BKX-US)較8月中旬高點下跌逾12%，遁入修正領域。
KBW那斯達克銀行指數今年迄今上漲3.3%，明顯落後標普500指數12%的漲幅。
借貸成本升高、公債殖利率走高以及信用風險疑慮，都壓縮銀行近期獲利預期。此外，Meta(META-US)代理型AI Mus問世也引發金融股拋售，因為這項技術可能威脅到民眾習慣將現金留在低利率支票帳戶中的行為，也就是所謂的「消費慣性」。
第一資本金融公司(Capital One Financial)(COF-US)、富國銀行(Wells Fargo)(WFC-US)與Huntington Bancshares(HBAN-US)是KBW銀行指數今年表現最差的成分股，跌幅分別為20%、14%與12%。

4、防禦型公用事業也失守 高殖利率削弱股息吸引力

防禦型的公用事業是另一個受到重創的類股，原因在於殖利率走高通常會讓債券相較公用事業股票更具吸引力。
標普500公用事業類股指數自2月歷史高點以來已下跌約17%，正逼近熊市區間。加上市場預期美國天然氣庫存增加，而短天期美債殖利率已高於公用事業通常足以吸引投資人的股息殖利率，都對該產業構成壓力。
10年期美債殖利率第3季大幅上升近1個百分點，創24年新高，標普500公用事業類股則下跌13%。該指數31檔成分股中，僅星座能源(Constellation Energy)(CEG-US)與AES(AES-US)兩家公司上漲。

5、高風險股票反而成為「避險撤退區」

市場中最具投機性的區塊也陷入困境，高盛集團(GS-US)追蹤未盈利一籃子科技公司的指數第3季下跌11%，是該指數同期次差單季表現，成分股包括Roku(ROKU-US)與Peloton(PTON-US)。
另據盛與彭博整理數據，資產負債表最脆弱、負債較高的企業第3季僅上漲1.9%，是2022年初、Fed展開升息循環以來最小的單季漲幅。
不過有一派押注Fed不會再大幅升息。Wealth Consulting Group執行長Jimmy Lee不認為美債殖利率飆升會失控，他表示，投資人只是在拋售對利率敏感的股票，他正以較低的估值買進金融與工業類股。
但他提醒道：「標普500指數最大的風險，是AI行情意外反轉。」
paras_en: US 10-year Treasury yields rose to 5.34% on Thursday (the 1st), a peak not seen since 2002, prompting traders to debate when bond‑market selling might start to weigh more heavily on an otherwise resilient US equity market. From inside the market, the rate spike has already dealt a serious blow.

Bloomberg reports that even though the S&P 500 is less than 2% away from its all‑time high, rate‑sensitive small‑cap stocks as well as banks and utilities have suffered sharp sell‑offs. Many speculative equities—including unprofitable tech firms and companies with the weakest balance sheets—have lagged the broader market since the Fed began its first rate hike in three years.

iCapital global investment strategist Dan Suzuki said, “Most of the market has already fallen at least 5% from its highs, and some sectors are down more than 15%. A large part of that is due to higher rates and the resulting tightening of financial conditions.”

The US equity market is showing a rare historical pattern: AI‑driven rallies are supporting prices, yet at the same time the market is operating in an environment that historically triggers sharp turbulence – heightened geopolitical risk, rising rates and uncertainty around the US mid‑term elections.

Eric Diton, president and managing director of The Wealth Alliance, said, “As long as the economy and corporate earnings keep growing strongly, the market can still tolerate higher yields.” He remains cautious on equities and has added energy stocks to hedge against the impact of higher bond yields and oil prices.
He added, “The biggest risk to the market is a problem with AI infrastructure. If profit outlooks are cut, it could spark broader market pain.”
The following five angles expose the hidden pressures beneath the market’s apparent prosperity:

1. Equal‑weight S&P 500 continues to weaken – market breadth lights up red. The S&P 500 Equal‑Weighted Index, which gives each component the same weight, may be on its seventh consecutive week of decline, reviving concerns that market breadth is too narrow. In other words, the current bull run is being driven mainly by a handful of large‑cap stocks.

If the weakness persists through Friday, it would mark the third time in history the equal‑weight S&P 500 has fallen for seven straight weeks. Bloomberg data show the previous two instances occurred after the 2002 dot‑com bust and during the 2022 bear‑market sell‑off.

Not everyone sees this as a sign that the bull market is ending. Michael Purves, CEO of Tallbacken Capital Advisors, argues it reflects a strong bull market and major disruptive innovation in tech. He targets the S&P 500 at 8,500 points by year‑end, implying roughly 11% upside.

2. Small‑caps take a beating – Russell 2000 on the brink of correction. Higher rates and yields are hitting small‑cap stocks, which typically carry more debt and less diversified businesses. The Russell 2000 lagged the S&P 500 by almost 10 percentage points in Q3, its worst relative performance since 1999.
The Russell 2000 is down 8.5% from its August 14 historic high, just one step away from a correction zone.

Speculative small‑caps are more exposed than large‑cap peers; financials and industrials, which are more cyclical, make up a larger share of the Russell 2000 than of the S&P 500, while the S&P 500 is weighted toward AI‑driven tech stocks that have shone this year.
Bloomberg data also show that “zombie stocks” – companies struggling or unable to service their debt interest – account for more than one‑third of the Russell 2000 constituents.

3. Bank stocks plunge – higher borrowing costs squeeze profit outlooks. Although US consumers keep spending and companies keep borrowing, which should help banks, bank shares have fallen sharply in recent weeks, dragging the KBW Nasdaq Bank Index (BKX‑US), composed of 24 large banks, more than 12% below its mid‑August peak and into correction territory.
The KBW Nasdaq Bank Index is up 3.3% year‑to‑date, still lagging the S&P 500’s 12% gain.

Rising borrowing costs, higher Treasury yields and credit‑risk concerns are compressing banks’ near‑term profit expectations. In addition, Meta’s new generative‑AI model, Mus, sparked a sell‑off in financial stocks because the technology could erode the habit of keeping cash in low‑interest checking accounts – the so‑called “consumption inertia.”
Capital One Financial (COF‑US), Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) and Huntington Bancshares (HBAN‑US) have been the worst performers in the KBX index this year, down 20%, 14% and 12% respectively.
4. Defensive utilities also falter – high yields erode dividend appeal. Defensive utility stocks have been hit hard because rising yields make bonds more attractive than utility equities.

Since its February peak, the S&P 500 Utilities Index has fallen about 17%, edging toward bear‑market territory. Adding to the pressure are expectations of higher US natural‑gas inventories and short‑term Treasury yields that now exceed the dividend yields that usually attract investors to utilities.

10‑year Treasury yields jumped nearly 1 percentage point in Q3, a 24‑year high, while the S&P 500 Utilities Index slid 13%. Of the index’s 31 components, only Constellation Energy (CEG‑US) and AES (AES‑US) posted gains.

5. High‑risk stocks become a “flight‑to‑safety” zone. The most speculative segment of the market is also under strain; Goldman Sachs’ (GS‑US) index of unprofitable tech companies fell 11% in Q3, the worst quarterly performance for that index, which includes stocks such as Roku (ROKU‑US) and Peloton (PTON‑US).
Bloomberg and Goldman data show that the most balance‑sheet‑fragile, highly leveraged firms rose only 1.9% in Q3 – the smallest quarterly gain since early 2022 when the Fed began its rate‑hike cycle.

However, some bet the Fed will not raise rates further. Jimmy Lee, CEO of Wealth Consulting Group, does not think the surge in Treasury yields will get out of control. He says investors are merely selling rate‑sensitive stocks, and he is buying financial and industrial shares at lower valuations.
He cautions, “The biggest risk to the S&P 500 is an unexpected reversal of the AI rally.”

items.title: 把AI搬上桌面！輝達推64GB新機 免靠雲端也能跑模型
items.title_en: Bringing AI to the Desktop! NVIDIA Launches 64GB DGX Spark, Runs Models Locally Without Cloud
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)正將AI代理商機延伸至開發者桌面，周五(2日)宣布10月23日透過合作品牌推出64GB版DGX Spark，售價4,999美元起，讓開發者在自己的設備上執行AI模型與代理。新配置可連接兩台設備擴大運算規模，顯示輝達除了供應大型AI基礎設施，也持續布局本地運算市場。
根據輝達公告，新產品將由宏碁(2353-TW)、華碩(2357-TW)、戴爾(DELL-US)、技嘉(2376-TW)、惠普(HPQ-US)與微星(2377-TW)推出，保留與128GB版本相同的GB10 Grace Blackwell超級晶片、DGX OS及AI軟體平台。

AI代理走向本地運算 硬體與軟體平台同步布局

輝達表示，64GB版本可在設備上執行最多1,000億參數的模型，適用於AI代理、推論、微調與資料科學。開發者可讓程式編寫或研究代理持續運作，處理程式碼審查、文件分析及多步驟任務，無須每項工作都依賴雲端服務。
這項產品的商業意義，在於將AI硬體需求延伸至開發者與研究團隊。隨著模型與代理應用在本地部署，輝達可透過GB10晶片、網路連接及CUDA軟體工具，爭取更多工作流程使用其平台。不過，這是依產品設計觀察的市場機會，公司尚未公布新配置的訂單或出貨預估。
DGX Spark支援Ollama、vLLM及PyTorch等工具，並提供輝達AI代理工具與Nemotron開放模型。月底預計推出的NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher，則將簡化模型下載、啟動與跨設備配置，降低使用者自行設定環境的負擔。
本地運算也讓開發者能在自己的設備上處理資料，對重視隱私或需要持續執行代理的工作具有吸引力。但購買硬體是否比使用雲端更划算，仍取決於使用頻率、模型需求與維護成本。

記憶體容量牽動擴充 售價與實際效能仍是考驗

當模型、上下文長度或同時運作的代理數量增加，記憶體容量就可能成為限制。輝達表示，兩台64GB設備可透過內建ConnectX-7網路連接，合計提供128GB記憶體，支援最多2,000億參數模型。
NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant會偵測連接設備、驗證配置並設定網路，使用者擴充時無須重新建立整套軟體環境。在輝達的Qwen 3.8 27B測試中，兩台64GB設備的效能最高達單台的1.7倍，不過這是針對特定模型的測試結果，不代表執行其他AI任務時，也能達到相同的效能提升。
從記憶體產業角度看，本地AI設備若逐漸普及，可望增加高容量記憶體的應用需求。輝達既有128GB版DGX Spark採用LPDDR5X統一記憶體；新64GB配置的具體供應商與採購規模，則未在這份公告中揭露。
因此，產品推出可視為本地AI市場布局的進展，尚不足以推論特定記憶體業者將大幅受惠。4,999美元起的售價，也意味市場仍須檢驗開發者是否願意投入，以及實際效能能否支持長期使用。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) is extending its AI agent business to developers' desktops, announcing on Friday the October 23 launch of a 64GB version of the DGX Spark starting at $4,999, allowing developers to run AI models and agents on their own hardware. The new configuration can link two devices to scale compute, showing NVIDIA is not only supplying large‑scale AI infrastructure but also continuing to target the local compute market.

According to NVIDIA’s announcement, the new product will be offered by Acer (2353-TW), ASUS (2357-TW), Dell (DELL-US), Gigabyte (2376-TW), HP (HPQ-US) and MSI (2377-TW), and will retain the same GB10 Grace Blackwell super‑chip, DGX OS and AI software platform as the 128GB version.

NVIDIA says the 64GB model can run up to 100 billion‑parameter models on‑device, suitable for AI agents, inference, fine‑tuning and data science. Developers can keep code‑writing or research agents running continuously for tasks such as code review, document analysis and multi‑step workflows without relying on cloud services for every job.

The commercial significance of the product lies in extending AI hardware demand to developers and research teams. As models and agents are deployed locally, NVIDIA can leverage the GB10 chip, network connectivity and CUDA tools to capture more workflow usage of its platform. However, this is a market opportunity inferred from product design; the company has not disclosed order or shipment forecasts for the new configuration.

DGX Spark supports tools such as Ollama, vLLM and PyTorch, and includes NVIDIA AI agent tools and the open Nemotron model. NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher, expected later this month, will simplify model download, launch and cross‑device configuration, reducing the burden of setting up environments manually.

Local compute also lets developers process data on their own machines, which is attractive for privacy‑sensitive work or tasks that require agents to run continuously. Whether buying hardware is more cost‑effective than using the cloud still depends on usage frequency, model requirements and maintenance costs.

Memory capacity becomes a limiting factor as model size, context length or the number of concurrent agents grow. NVIDIA notes that two 64GB units can be linked via built‑in ConnectX‑7 networking to provide a combined 128GB of memory, supporting models up to 200 billion parameters.

NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant detects connected devices, validates configurations and sets up networking, so users can expand without rebuilding the entire software stack. In NVIDIA’s Qwen 3.8 27B benchmark, two 64GB units achieved up to 1.7× the performance of a single unit, though this result applies only to that specific model and does not guarantee similar gains for other AI tasks.

From a memory‑industry perspective, wider adoption of local AI devices could boost demand for high‑capacity memory. NVIDIA’s existing 128GB DGX Spark uses LPDDR5X unified memory; the specific suppliers and procurement scale for the new 64GB configuration were not disclosed in the announcement.

Thus, the product launch marks progress in NVIDIA’s local AI market strategy but is insufficient to conclude that any particular memory vendor will see a major benefit. The starting price of $4,999 also means the market must still test whether developers are willing to invest and whether real‑world performance justifies long‑term use.

items.title: 歐債疑慮引發避險潮 瑞士法郎再成為避險寵兒
items.title_en: European Debt Concerns Spark Safe‑Haven Rally, Swiss Franc Again a Safe‑Haven Darling
paras: 受法國債務狀況引發歐洲市場疑慮影響，瑞士法郎再度成為市場避險焦點。隨著投資人對法國在明年大選前遏止債務的能力產生疑慮，瑞郎兌歐元迎來自去年 4 月以來表現最佳的一周。雖然瑞郎先前因低利率與零殖利率特性而走勢疲軟，但鄰國動盪促使資金迅速回流。

市場數據與交易現況

數據顯示，瑞郎在短短兩天內暴漲約 1.8%，歐元兌瑞郎匯率於周五跌至約 0.93 的兩個月新低。
根據芝加哥商品交易所(CME Group)資料，周四的交易量約為今年平均水準的 4 倍。此外，選擇權定價顯示資金湧入瑞郎的速度創下四年多來新高，未來一年的看多情緒升至 3 月以來最高點。
瑞郎因與黃金的歷史聯繫，長期被視為市場劇烈拋售時的避風港；且瑞士利率極低，平時常被用作套利交易的融資貨幣。

專家觀點

對於此波強勁漲勢，荷蘭國際集團(ING)外匯策略師Francesco Pesole 表示：「當歐元區的債務風險驟升時，瑞郎總是首選的避險貨幣。」Pesole 與德國商業銀行外匯策略師Michael Pfister 均認為這波反彈令人意外，原先預估市場會等到明年法國與義大利大選前夕才有所反應。
彭博策略師Mark Cranfield分析，瑞郎短期利率雖處於負值區域，但作為總體對沖工具時有進一步走低的前例；相反地，市場對歐洲央行(ECB)升息的預期未能支撐歐元，反映出對政策失誤可能損害歐元的擔憂，歐元兌瑞郎恐才剛開始更深幅度的下探。
Pfister 補充指出，隨著各國公布 2027 年籌資計畫，財政健全度將受到嚴格審視，而瑞士較為平衡的預算將持續吸引投資人。他預測，瑞郎未來一年將再升值逾 2%，推動歐元兌瑞郎降至 0.91，他表示：「老實說，現在能躲避風險的地方已經不多了。」
paras_en: The Swiss franc has once again become the market’s safe‑haven focus as concerns over France’s debt situation ripple through European markets. With investors doubting France’s ability to curb its debt before next year’s election, the franc‑to‑euro pair posted its best week since April last year. Although the franc had previously been weak due to low rates and zero‑yield characteristics, turmoil in the neighboring country quickly drove funds back into it.
Market data and trading activity show the franc surged about 1.8% in just two days, and the euro‑to‑franc exchange rate fell to roughly 0.93 on Friday, a two‑month low.

According to CME Group data, Thursday’s trading volume was about four times the average for the year. Moreover, options pricing indicates that the speed of capital flowing into the franc hit a four‑year high, and bullish sentiment for the next 12 months rose to its strongest level since March.

The franc, historically linked to gold, has long been viewed as a safe haven during sharp market sell‑offs; Switzerland’s ultra‑low rates also make the currency a popular funding vehicle for arbitrage trades.

Expert view: ING foreign‑exchange strategist Francesco Pesole said, “When debt risk in the euro area spikes, the franc is always the top safe‑haven currency.” Both Pesole and German commercial bank FX strategist Michael Pfister said the rebound was surprising, as they had originally expected the market to wait until the run‑up to next year’s French and Italian elections to react.

Bloomberg strategist Mark Cranfield noted that while short‑term Swiss rates are in negative territory, there is precedent for the franc to fall further when used as a broad hedge. Conversely, market expectations of ECB rate hikes failed to support the euro, reflecting worries that policy missteps could damage the currency, and the euro‑to‑franc pair may only be beginning a deeper decline.

Pfister added that as countries release their 2027 financing plans, fiscal soundness will be scrutinized closely, and Switzerland’s relatively balanced budget will continue to attract investors. He predicts the franc will appreciate by more than 2% over the next year, pushing the euro‑to‑franc rate down to 0.91, and said, “Honestly, there aren’t many places to hide from risk anymore.”

items.title: 〈台幣〉亞幣轉強！逆勢翻升收31.83元 觀望美非農報告
items.title_en: TWD: Asian Currencies Strengthen! Defying Trend, Rises to 31.83, Awaiting US Nonfarm Payrolls
paras: 市場關注美國稍晚即將公布的非農就業數據，台北匯市整體交投轉趨冷清，新台幣兌美元今 (2) 日盤中一度貶破 31.9 元關卡，外資雙向進出，但整體亞幣偏升，尾盤在央行調節下，新台幣終場以31.83元作收，小升1.2分，為連 3 升，台北與元太外匯總成交值萎縮至 21.91 億美元。
台北股匯本周僅有四個交易日，由於美伊衝突未見緩解，使得美元本周較為強勢，新台幣兌美元累計貶值5分或0.16%，周線再度翻黑。
台股電子權值股今(2)日多無表態，早盤呈現震盪走勢，但被動元件、光通訊、PCB、矽晶圓等中小型股接棒演出，帶動大盤走揚，最高漲至48491.62點，距盤中歷史新高 48601.53 點僅差臨門一腳，終場漲 122.25 點，收 48475.74 點，仍寫收盤新高，成交量8981.74億元。外資今天買超台股 26.22 億元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 31.87 元，盤中一度貶近 1 角，最低來到 31.935 元，不過，為避免新台幣走勢與主要亞幣脫鉤太多，央行適時進場調節，帶動匯價由貶轉升，收在 31.83 元。
觀察主要貨幣今天表現，根據央行統計，韓元強升 1.13%，成為本日最強亞幣，日元亦勁揚 0.51%，星幣升值 0.15%，新台幣小升 0.04%，人民幣則因十一長假休市。
周三數據顯示，美國8月通膨增幅低於預期，且7月數據遭到下修，降低了市場對聯準會本月升息的預期。市場將焦點轉向美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 即將公布的 9 月非農就業報告，這將是Fed 評估下一步利率政策的重要依據。
paras_en: The market is focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll data that will be released later today. Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market turned relatively quiet, and the New Taiwan dollar slipped below the 31.9 per USD mark during the session. Foreign investors were active on both sides, but overall Asian currencies were on the rise. In the final minutes, after central‑bank intervention, the TWD closed at 31.83 per USD, a modest gain of 0.12 and the third consecutive rise. The total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market shrank to $2.191 billion.

Taipei’s stock and FX market had only four trading days this week. Because the U.S.–Iran conflict showed no sign of easing, the dollar remained relatively strong, and the TWD/USD pair depreciated a cumulative 5 ticks, or 0.16%, turning the weekly chart back into the red.

Taiwan’s heavyweight electronic stocks gave little guidance today, with the early session showing a choppy range. However, small‑ and mid‑cap stocks in passive components, optical communications, PCBs and silicon wafers took the lead, lifting the index to a high of 48,491.62 points—just 110 points shy of the intraday record of 48,601.53. The market closed up 122.25 points at 48,475.74, still posting a new closing high, with a turnover of NT$898.174 billion. Foreign investors were net buyers of NT$2.622 billion of Taiwan equities today.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.87 per USD and fell nearly 0.10 during the session, reaching a low of 31.935. To prevent the TWD from drifting too far from the major Asian currencies, the central bank stepped in, turning the depreciation into appreciation and ending the day at 31.83.

Looking at the performance of major currencies today, central‑bank data show the Korean won surged 1.13%, making it the strongest Asian currency of the day. The Japanese yen also rose sharply by 0.51%, the Star coin appreciated 0.15%, the New Taiwan dollar edged up 0.04%, while the Chinese renminbi was closed for the National Day holiday.

Wednesday’s data showed that August U.S. inflation rose less than expected and July’s figures were revised lower, easing market expectations of a Fed rate hike this month. Attention now shifts to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics’ upcoming September non‑farm payroll report, which will be a key reference for the Fed’s next interest‑rate decision.

items.title: 川普憂弱勢日元衝擊美貿易 高市：日元低估本身就是問題
items.title_en: Trump Worried Weak Yen Threatens US Trade; Kōchi: Yen Undervaluation Is a Problem in Itself
paras: 日本首相高市早苗周四(1日)透露，她上個月在紐約與美國總統川普會談時，被告知日元疲弱正導致美國貿易面臨困境。
高市接受日本電視台(NTV)獨家專訪，被問到美日雙方是否就如何處理日元疲弱問題取得一致時，她說：「在日美領袖會談中，對方提到美國貿易因日元疲弱而面臨困難，我則回應，按照一般原則，日元被低估本身就是一個問題。」
高市並透露與財務大臣片山皐月對談時獲悉，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)曾表示，他理解日本政府的經濟政策，也沒有就政策方向提出任何要求。
她在周四晚間播出的專訪中說：「我們在繼續負責任且積極的財政政策下，追求強健經濟與永續財政的想法並沒有改變。」
川普政府近來罕見頻頻表達對日元疲弱的關切。貝森特多次暗示，日本銀行(央行，BOJ)應升息，以協助日元找到適當價位。他在德州一所大學演講時曾說，他對日本政策制定者接下來的行動「相當有把握」，甚至向投機客嗆聲「我是莊家」，要求他們押注日元貶值、與他對作。
先前日元兌美元貶至164附近之後，日美當局曾共同介入外匯市場，是雙方美日28年來首次聯手支撐日元。川普當時形容，這項干預是友誼的象徵。
日本官員通常會淡化美方言論對日本政策制定方面的影響。高市在專訪中避免對外匯市場做出具體評論，轉而談及她對經濟振興的願景，強調這將有助於支撐日元。
她說：「我們希望透過大膽投資風險管理與成長領域，提高日本潛在經濟成長率並強化供應能力，以實現強健經濟。我相信，提高日本經濟的競爭力，最終將有助於建立對日元的信心。」
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Naoto Kōchi said on Thursday (the 1st) that during her meeting with US President Donald Trump in New York last month, she was told that a weak yen is causing difficulties for US trade.

In an exclusive interview with Japan's NTV, when asked whether the US and Japan had reached a consensus on how to handle the weak yen, she said: “During the US‑Japan leaders’ talks, the US side mentioned that American trade is facing challenges because of the weak yen. I responded that, as a general principle, an undervalued yen is itself a problem.”

Kōchi also revealed that in a conversation with Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama she learned that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had said he understands Japan’s economic policy and has not made any demands regarding its direction.
In the interview aired Thursday evening she said: “Our commitment to responsible and proactive fiscal policy, and our pursuit of a strong economy and sustainable finances, remains unchanged.”

The Trump administration has lately expressed unusually frequent concern over the weak yen. Bessent has repeatedly hinted that the Bank of Japan should raise rates to help the yen find an appropriate level. Speaking at a Texas university, he said he is “quite confident” about the next steps Japanese policymakers will take and even taunted speculators, saying “I’m the house” and urging them to bet on yen depreciation in line with his view.

After the yen fell to around 164 per dollar, US and Japanese authorities jointly intervened in the foreign‑exchange market – the first US‑Japan coordinated support for the yen in 28 years. Trump at the time described the intervention as a symbol of friendship.

Japanese officials usually downplay the impact of US statements on Japan’s policy‑making. In the interview Kōchi avoided specific comments on the FX market, instead discussing her vision for economic revitalisation and stressing that it would help support the yen.

She said: “We aim to boost Japan’s potential growth rate and strengthen supply capacity through bold investment, risk management and growth‑sector focus, to achieve a robust economy. I believe that enhancing Japan’s competitiveness will ultimately help build confidence in the yen.”

items.title: 東京9月核心CPI漲2.7%超預期 支持升息預期
items.title_en: Tokyo September Core CPI Rises 2.7% Beyond Expectations, Supporting Rate‑Hike Outlook
paras: 日本總務省公布9月東京都區部排除生鮮食品的核心消費者物價指數，年增率達2.7%，高於市場預期的2.3%至2.4%，為連續第4個月擴大增幅，並創下8個月來首次重返2%上方。排除生鮮食品與能源後的雙核心CPI年增率更攀升至3.0%。
由於東京數據為日本全國物價的先行指標，數據公布後日元應聲走強，美元兌日元匯率跌破158關卡。
總務省說明，本次物價推升主因包含幼兒托育免費效應減退、基本水費免費政策結束，以及連假效應拉高住宿與旅遊費用；此外，晶片價格上漲與AI需求帶動電腦等娛樂耐久財價格走高。
針對通膨動向，國際通貨研究所上席研究員久後翔太郎表示，雖然幼兒托育等特殊政策影響顯著，但「剔除一時性因素後，基底物價的上揚壓力持續增強並未改變」。他認為這將支持日本央行加快升息步調，年內再次升息「幾乎無庸置疑」，若日元急貶，甚至不排除於10月動手。
彭博經濟學資深經濟學家木村太郎則指出，數據超預期主要是政策因素推高，「物價基調並非驟然改變」。但他補充說明，能源價格上漲、日元貶值及人工成本增加正波及廣泛品項，基底通膨動能仍相當強勁。
日本央行已於9月會議將政策利率調升至1.25%，總裁植田和男先前強調政策進入「局面變化」，對進一步升息抱持正面態度。目前利率交換市場已幾乎完全預估12月前將再次升息。
paras_en: Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications reported that the core consumer price index for Tokyo’s metropolitan area in September, excluding fresh food, rose 2.7% year‑on‑year, above the market forecast of 2.3%‑2.4%. This marks the fourth consecutive month of accelerating growth and the first time in eight months that the rate has returned above 2%. The “double‑core” CPI, which also excludes energy, climbed to a 3.0% annual increase.
Because Tokyo’s data is seen as a leading indicator for Japan’s nationwide inflation, the yen strengthened after the release, with the dollar‑yen rate slipping below the 158 level.

The ministry explained that the price rise was driven mainly by the waning effect of free childcare for infants, the end of a policy providing free basic water, and a holiday‑related surge in accommodation and travel costs. In addition, higher chip prices and AI‑driven demand lifted the prices of computers and other entertainment‑durable goods.

Commenting on the inflation trend, senior researcher Shōtarō Kuho of the International Monetary Research Institute said that although special policies such as free childcare have a noticeable impact, “once temporary factors are stripped out, the upward pressure on underlying prices continues to intensify and has not changed.” He believes this will support the Bank of Japan in accelerating its rate‑hike pace, making another hike within the year “almost a certainty,” and if the yen were to depreciate sharply, a move as early as October cannot be ruled out.

Senior Bloomberg economist Taro Kimura noted that the data beating expectations was mainly due to policy‑related factors and that “the overall price trend has not suddenly shifted.” He added that rising energy prices, yen depreciation and higher labor costs are affecting a broad range of items, keeping core inflation momentum still very strong.

The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% at its September meeting. Governor Kazuo Ueda had previously emphasized that policy was entering a “changing landscape” and expressed a positive stance toward further hikes. The interest‑rate swap market now almost fully prices in another rate increase before December.

U.S. August inflation rose less than expected and July data were revised down, easing the urgency for the Federal Reserve to raise rates again this month. However, the ongoing Middle East war continues to push up global prices, driving U.S. 10‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields to fresh highs not seen since June 2007 and June 2002 respectively, supporting the dollar at a two‑month high on Thursday. In addition, S&P Global reported that Japan’s September manufacturing PMI fell to a six‑month low of 54.1, while the Bank of Japan’s short‑term business survey showed that large‑manufacturing firms’ confidence index for Q3 hit its highest level since March 2018 at +24. Conversely, the large non‑manufacturing confidence index slipped for the first time in five quarters to +35. Companies now expect consumer prices to rise an average 2.6% over the next year, lower than three months ago. The BOJ’s September meeting minutes reveal that most policymakers think rate hikes should accelerate, but two dovish members of the nine‑person policy board opposed a September increase. Markets think the BOJ may pause in October, a view that has weighed on the yen and pushed USD/JPY up from its low of 157.31.

A televised interview with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi showed her vowing to boost economic competitiveness to support the yen. Meanwhile, U.S. initial jobless claims fell to 197,000 and August construction spending rose 0.9% versus expectations. Even though S&P Global and the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) reported September U.S. manufacturing PMIs of 55.9 and 54.5 respectively, Fed Vice‑Chair Jefferson and Minneapolis Fed President Kashkari both said the Fed’s next move remains uncertain, keeping the dollar up to a high of 158.45 against the yen. The dollar‑yen resistance today is seen around 158.30‑158.50 with support at 157.20‑157.40.
EUR/USD

Australian Bureau of Statistics data showed that a sharp rebound in data‑center equipment imports offset a strong rebound in gold exports, narrowing the August trade surplus to A$495 million, below expectations. Moreover, the three‑month vacancy rate fell 0.9% to the lowest level since early 2022, putting pressure on the Aussie and dragging the euro‑dollar pair down from its high of 1.1336.

Yet higher oil prices and inflation shocks are hurting the economy, prompting investors to sell European assets. Reports that China has halted fuel exports and the U.S. military has increased its presence in the Middle East have further battered the euro‑dollar pair, pulling it down to a low of 1.1214 ahead of the U.S. jobs report. items.title: Fed蘿根：至少應再升息2碼  並需連番升息來抵銷去年秋季降息
items.title_en: Fed Logan: At Least Two More Rate Hikes Needed, With Consecutive Increases to Counter Last Fall’s Cuts
paras: 達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)週四(1日)表示，聯準會(Fed)至少應該再升息2碼(50個基點)。
她在一場演講中話道：「聯準會的政策立場一直偏離正軌，聯準會應該升息，目標至少為加50個基點。且至少需要進一步升息數次，才能抵銷去年秋季的降息，因為若無較高的利率，通膨無法達到聯準會2%目標。」
蘿根還表示，長債殖利率走高顯示市場參與者預期未來利率水準更高，她將密切關注美債殖利率走勢並評估其對經濟、融資成本和貨幣政策的影響。
她認為，長端殖利率上升未必只來自政策預期，也可能反映期限溢價走高。若投資人要求更高補償、期限溢價上升，會自然推高借貸成本，在一定程度上取代Fed緊縮，進而降低進一步升息的必要性。
但蘿根強調，Fed不會僅因長債殖利率上漲就預設行動，而會結合通膨、就業與金融環境判斷。
蘿根曾在2023年的演講中詳細介紹她所參考的各類美債市場模型。她表示，會持續觀察殖利率走勢以及經濟其他方面，以此判斷何種利率水準能對經濟形成一定抑制效果。
蘿根今年在聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)是擁有投票資格的決策官員，但作為地區聯準銀行總裁，她的言論仍被視為政策方向的重要參考。
paras_en: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said on Thursday (the 1st) that the Federal Reserve should raise rates by at least two more increments, equivalent to 50 basis points.

In her speech she said, “The Fed’s policy stance has been off track; the Fed should raise rates, targeting at least an additional 50 basis points. Several more hikes will be needed to offset the rate cuts made last autumn, because without higher rates inflation cannot reach the Fed’s 2% goal.”

Logan also noted that rising long‑term bond yields indicate market participants expect higher future rates, and she will closely monitor U.S. Treasury yield movements and assess their impact on the economy, financing costs, and monetary policy.

She argued that the rise in long‑end yields may not stem solely from policy expectations; it could also reflect a higher term premium. If investors demand greater compensation and term premiums rise, borrowing costs will naturally increase, partially substituting for Fed tightening and reducing the need for further hikes.
Nonetheless, Logan emphasized that the Fed will not act solely on higher long‑term yields; decisions will be based on a combination of inflation, employment, and financial‑market conditions.

Logan previously detailed the various Treasury‑market models she follows in a 2023 speech, saying she will continue to watch yield trends and other economic indicators to gauge what level of rates can exert a sufficient restraining effect on the economy.

Logan is a voting member of the Federal Open Market Committee this year, and although she serves as a regional Fed president, her comments are still regarded as an important reference for the direction of policy.

paras: 美元周四(1日)上漲，兌歐元周四升至17個月高點，全球債券遭遇拋售，推動美國與歐洲政府公債殖利率升至新高，同時油價上漲也加劇市場對通膨的擔憂。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.51%，盤中一度升至2025年4月以來最高水準。
截至9月底，美元兌一籃子貨幣已連續第6季上漲，創下2022年以來最長連漲紀錄。2022年期間，美國升息速度快於其他國家。
歐元兌美元跌破1.1215美元，為2025年5月以來首次。過去幾個月美元持續走強，部分原因是美國公債殖利率出現自1994年以來最大單季升幅。
歐元兌美元下跌0.77%，至1.12433美元。歐元9月下跌近2.5%，創下2025年7月以來最大單月跌幅。
NatWest Markets G10外匯策略主管Brian Daingerfield表示，「殖利率走高是多項因素共同作用的結果，尤其是市場對財政政策的擔憂，包括法國債券市場出現部分疲弱跡象，可能正蔓延至全球市場。此外，市場也持續擔心能源價格與通膨走高。」
他指出，「市場預期各國央行將持續收緊政策，其中也包括聯準會(Fed)。過去幾天，在我們昨天公布的部分個人消費支出(PCE)數據公布後，這種預期有所回落。但整體而言，市場普遍認為聯準會可能還會進一步收緊政策。」
美國10年期公債殖利率當日升至2002年以來最高水準，最新下跌5.65個基點至5.237%。
歐元兌日元與瑞郎也同步下跌，兌英鎊則勉強維持正值。法國政府財政狀況不穩引發市場擔憂，推動法國公債殖利率飆升至14年新高。德國指標性公債也遭到拋售。
Klarity FX總監Amo Sahota表示，「幾周以來，美元一直持續走強，而市場時不時就會出現一個新的敘事，為美元提供進一步上漲的動力。」
「但我認為最新的這個因素可能是最令人擔憂的，也就是歐洲市場出現恐慌。法國債務實在太高，加上法國與德國之間的利差擴大，讓所有人都感到不安。歐元因此大幅走弱，而且跌勢再次加速。」
周三公布數據顯示，美國8月通膨增幅低於預期，且7月數據遭到下修，降低了市場對聯準會本月升息的預期。不過，歐元區通膨大幅上升，凸顯能源價格上漲持續對全球經濟構成威脅。
全球債券在9月出現多年來最大單月跌幅，推動殖利率走高，原因包括政府財政狀況惡化、公債發行供給過多，以及通膨升溫等多項因素。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.49%，至1.32美元。英鎊9月下跌2.1%，但兌歐元持穩。歐元兌英鎊約報85.18便士，為6月底以來最低水準。
